attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Scheduling Module; Internal Schedule Versioning Standard

attributes.name: scte35_cue_count
attributes.description: Total number of SCTE-35 digital program insertion cue markers embedded in the schedule for this channel day. SCTE-35 cues signal ad break opportunities for Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) in both linear and OTT streams. Used to validate DAI readiness.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message Standard; Society of Cable Telecommunications Engineers (SCTE)

attributes.name: simulcast_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule is configured for simultaneous multi-platform broadcast (simulcast). True = the schedule is transmitted concurrently across linear broadcast and one or more OTT/streaming platforms. Drives Ericsson MediaFirst simulcast automation configuration.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC Advanced Television Systems Committee Standards

attributes.name: simulcast_platform_count
attributes.description: Number of platforms on which this schedule is simultaneously broadcast when simulcast_flag is True. Used for multi-platform distribution planning and rights compliance verification across linear, OTT, and vMVPD delivery channels.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the broadcast timezone in which this schedule's times are expressed (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Critical for accurate EPG display, daypart classification, and regulatory compliance reporting across markets.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; ATSC A/65 PSIP Standard

attributes.name: total_ad_time_seconds
attributes.description: Total planned advertising airtime in seconds across all ad pods in the schedule for this channel day. Used for commercial inventory management, FCC commercial limits compliance, and revenue forecasting against Wide Orbit traffic orders.
attributes.references: FCC Commercial Limits Rules (47 CFR Part 73); Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System

attributes.name: total_program_time_seconds
attributes.description: Total planned programming (non-commercial) airtime in seconds for this channel day schedule. Equals total_runtime_seconds minus total_ad_time_seconds. Used for content utilization reporting and rights compliance verification.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Scheduling Module; Rightsline Rights Management

attributes.name: total_runtime_seconds
attributes.description: Total planned runtime of all program items in the schedule, expressed in seconds. Used to validate that the schedule fills the full broadcast day (86,400 seconds for a 24-hour schedule) and to detect gaps or overlaps in the rundown.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Scheduling Module; SMPTE ST 12-1 Timecode Standard

attributes.name: transmission_type
attributes.description: Indicates the primary mode of content delivery for this schedule. 'linear' = traditional scheduled broadcast; 'vod_window' = on-demand programming window; 'fast_channel' = Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television (FAST) channel; 'simulcast' = simultaneous multi-platform broadcast.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Impression Measurement Guidelines; ATSC Advanced Television Systems Committee Standards

attributes.name: transmitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the approved schedule was transmitted to the Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation system. Marks the transition from 'approved' to 'transmitted' status. Used for playout readiness SLA monitoring and failover preparation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: wide_orbit_log_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the corresponding traffic log in Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing system. Links the program schedule to the ad scheduling and affidavit records for commercial break reconciliation and proof-of-broadcast (affidavit) generation.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System

products.name: schedule_slot
products.description: Individual time slot within a program schedule representing a single content event or break event on a linear channel. Captures slot sequence number, planned start time, planned duration, actual start time (as-run), actual duration, slot type (program, promo, commercial break, filler, PSA, EAS), content reference, daypart assignment, and live/tape flag. The atomic unit of the EPG rundown managed in Ericsson MediaFirst.

attributes.name: schedule_slot_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual schedule slot record within the Electronic Program Guide (EPG) rundown. Primary key for the schedule_slot data product managed in Ericsson MediaFirst.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: ad_pod_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ad pod (group of commercials within a break) associated with this slot when the slot type is a commercial break. Populated only for commercial break slots; null for program and promo slots.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST)

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the linear broadcast channel on which this schedule slot is programmed. Identifies the originating channel within the EPG grid.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol

attributes.name: compliance_content_rating_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.content_rating. Business justification: Each scheduled slot requires verified content rating for daypart appropriateness (watershed compliance), V-chip encoding, and parental guidance systems. Real-time compliance verification prevents regu

attributes.name: content_episode_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.content_episode. Business justification: Schedulers assign specific episodes to slots for EPG accuracy, rights clearance per episode, and as-run log generation. The existing title_id FK is insufficient — episode-level identification is requi

attributes.name: daypart_id
attributes.description: Reference to the daypart classification assigned to this slot (e.g., Prime Time, Late Night, Morning Drive). Dayparts are standard time segments of the broadcast day used for audience targeting and advertising rate-card pricing.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research; IAB Daypart Standards

attributes.name: grant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rights.grant. Business justification: Schedule slots require grant verification for pre-broadcast rights clearance. Critical for automated compliance workflow preventing unauthorized airings. Broadcasters validate grant coverage before fi

attributes.name: holdback_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rights.holdback. Business justification: Slots must check holdback restrictions during scheduling to prevent rights violations. Automated enforcement workflow blocks scheduling content during holdback windows (e.g., theatrical holdbacks, SVO

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Slots may require specific transmission equipment for live events, special broadcasts, or equipment-specific configurations - supports technical coordination, equipment allocation, and signal routing

attributes.name: program_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent broadcast schedule or rundown document that contains this slot. Links the atomic slot to its daily or weekly schedule container in Ericsson MediaFirst.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: talent_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to talent.talent_profile. Business justification: On-air talent (hosts, anchors, guests) are scheduled in broadcast slots. Scheduling systems track which talent appears in which slot for call sheets, union reporting, rights clearance verification, an

attributes.name: version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.version. Business justification: Playout automation and QC require knowing which specific technical version (resolution, audio codec, language) is scheduled in each slot. Version-level scheduling drives pre-transmission QC checks and

attributes.name: actual_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Real-world duration of the slot in seconds as recorded in the as-run log. Compared against planned_duration_seconds to identify overruns, underruns, and schedule compliance deviations. Used in affidavit reconciliation and makegoods processing.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst As-Run Log; Wide Orbit Affidavit

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: Real-world start time of the slot as recorded in the as-run log by Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation. May differ from planned_start_time due to live events, technical delays, or schedule overruns. Critical for affidavit generation in Wide Orbit and Nielsen audience measurement reconciliation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst As-Run Log; Wide Orbit Affidavit; FCC Broadcast Record-Keeping Rules

attributes.name: aspect_ratio
attributes.description: Video aspect ratio of the content assigned to this slot. Drives playout automation letterboxing/pillarboxing decisions in Ericsson MediaFirst and ensures compliance with broadcast technical standards.
attributes.references: ATSC A/53 Digital Television Standard; DVB Technical Standards

attributes.name: audio_format
attributes.description: Audio encoding format for the content in this slot (e.g., stereo, Dolby 5.1, Dolby Atmos, mono). Required for playout automation configuration in Ericsson MediaFirst and compliance with broadcast audio loudness standards.
attributes.references: ATSC A/85 Techniques for Establishing and Maintaining Audio Loudness; Ericsson MediaFirst

attributes.name: automation_event_code
attributes.description: Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation system event identifier for this slot. The native key from the MediaFirst rundown used for as-run reconciliation, failover event tracking, and technical operations audit.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: broadcast_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this slot is scheduled to air, expressed in yyyy-MM-dd format. Used as the primary partition key for EPG queries, Nielsen ratings alignment, and daily schedule reporting. Represents the broadcast day which may span midnight for overnight programming.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Audience Measurement; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: closed_caption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether closed captioning is present and enabled for this slot (True). Mandatory for FCC compliance under the Twenty-First Century Communications and Video Accessibility Act (CVAA) for applicable programming.
attributes.references: FCC Closed Captioning Rules 47 CFR Part 79; Twenty-First Century Communications and Video Accessibility Act (CVAA)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule slot record was first created in the EPG system. Supports audit trail requirements, schedule change history analysis, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; FCC Broadcast Record-Keeping Rules

attributes.name: eas_alert_type
attributes.description: Type of Emergency Alert System (EAS) message associated with this slot when slot_type is 'eas' (e.g., EAN — Emergency Action Notification, NPT — National Periodic Test, RWT — Required Weekly Test). Null for non-EAS slots. Mandatory for FCC EAS compliance logging. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EAN|NPT|RWT|SVR|TOR|FFW|HUW|WSW — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FCC Emergency Alert System Rules 47 CFR Part 11; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: is_blackout
attributes.description: Indicates whether a geographic broadcast restriction (blackout) applies to this slot (True). Blackout rules are enforced at the distribution layer and must be flagged at the slot level for rights compliance and audience measurement exclusion.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights Management; FCC Syndicated Exclusivity and Network Non-Duplication Rules 47 CFR Part 76

attributes.name: is_live
attributes.description: Indicates whether this slot carries a live broadcast event (True) or pre-recorded/taped content (False). Live slots require different playout automation handling, DAI configuration, and rights clearance verification in Rightsline.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Rightsline Rights Management

attributes.name: is_repeat
attributes.description: Indicates whether this slot is a repeat airing of previously broadcast content (True) rather than a first-run premiere (False). Affects talent residuals calculations in Rightsline and Nielsen audience measurement weighting.
attributes.references: Rightsline Royalty Calculations; Nielsen Media Research

attributes.name: is_simulcast
attributes.description: Indicates whether this slot is simultaneously broadcast across multiple platforms or channels (True). Simulcast slots require coordinated playout across linear and OTT/streaming distribution paths and may trigger additional rights obligations.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Rightsline Rights Management

attributes.name: isan_code
attributes.description: International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN) uniquely identifying the audiovisual work airing in this slot. Enables cross-platform content identification, rights clearance verification in Rightsline, and royalty calculation for residuals.
attributes.references: ISO 15706 International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN); ISAN International Agency

attributes.name: isci_code
attributes.description: Industry Standard Commercial Identification (ISCI) code for the commercial spot airing in this slot. An 8-character alphanumeric code used by Wide Orbit and ad agencies to uniquely identify a specific commercial creative. Null for non-commercial slot types.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; ISCI/Ad-ID Standard (American Association of Advertising Agencies)

attributes.name: must_carry_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this slot is subject to must-carry obligations requiring MVPDs to include this channel/content in their basic tier (True). Flags slots that cannot be blacked out or substituted under FCC must-carry rules.
attributes.references: FCC Must-Carry Rules 47 CFR Part 76; Cable Television Consumer Protection and Competition Act

attributes.name: nielsen_program_code
attributes.description: Nielsen Media Research proprietary program code assigned to the content in this slot. Used to match as-run schedule data with Nielsen ratings data for audience measurement, GRP/TRP calculation, and advertiser reporting.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Audience Measurement Platform

attributes.name: planned_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Intended duration of the slot in seconds as scheduled in the EPG rundown. Used for schedule integrity validation, ad pod capacity planning, and compliance with broadcast standards for minimum program duration.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SCTE-35

attributes.name: planned_end_time
attributes.description: Scheduled end date and time for this slot as defined in the EPG rundown. Derived from planned_start_time plus planned_duration_seconds but stored explicitly to support EPG grid queries and boundary validation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65 EPG Standard

attributes.name: planned_start_time
attributes.description: Scheduled start date and time for this slot as defined in the EPG rundown prior to broadcast. Expressed in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for EPG publication, audience measurement alignment, and ad trafficking in Wide Orbit.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65 EPG Standard

attributes.name: resolution
attributes.description: Video resolution classification of the content in this slot (SD, HD, UHD, 4K). Determines the playout chain and CDN delivery profile used by Akamai and affects carriage fee agreements with MVPDs.
attributes.references: ATSC A/53 Digital Television Standard; DVB Project Technical Standards

attributes.name: schedule_version
attributes.description: Version number of the schedule rundown in which this slot was last modified. Incremented each time the EPG rundown is revised in Ericsson MediaFirst. Supports schedule change audit trails and version comparison for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: scte35_cue_in_time
attributes.description: Timestamp of the SCTE-35 splice_insert cue-in signal marking the return to primary program content after an ad break. Paired with scte35_cue_out_time to define the exact ad avail window for DAI and Wide Orbit ad scheduling.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message for Cable and Satellite Distribution

attributes.name: scte35_cue_out_time
attributes.description: Timestamp of the SCTE-35 splice_insert cue-out signal marking the start of an ad break or content interruption within this slot. Used by Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) systems and downstream distribution platforms to trigger ad replacement. Null for non-break slot types.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message for Cable and Satellite Distribution

attributes.name: slot_sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this slot within the daily rundown for the channel. Determines the playout order in Ericsson MediaFirst automation. Sequence numbers are contiguous integers starting at 1 for each broadcast day.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: slot_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the schedule slot within the EPG workflow. Values: scheduled (initial EPG entry), confirmed (locked for playout), on_air (currently broadcasting), completed (as-run recorded), cancelled (removed from schedule), replaced (substituted with alternate content). Drives Ericsson MediaFirst automation state machine.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: slot_type
attributes.description: Classification of the schedule slot by content category. Values: program (primary editorial content), promo (promotional spot), commercial_break (paid advertising break), filler (interstitial padding content), psa (Public Service Announcement), eas (Emergency Alert System message). Drives playout automation logic and ad insertion rules in Ericsson MediaFirst.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message; ATSC A/65; FCC Emergency Alert System Rules 47 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: traffic_order_number
attributes.description: Wide Orbit traffic system order number associated with this slot when it carries a commercial or promotional spot. Links the EPG slot to the ad sales order for affidavit generation, billing reconciliation, and makegood processing.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Ad Trafficking Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule slot record was last modified. Tracks EPG edits, schedule revisions, and as-run updates. Used in conjunction with schedule_version for change management and compliance audit.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

products.name: epg_entry
products.description: Published Electronic Program Guide record distributed to MVPDs, vMVPDs, set-top boxes, and digital platforms for viewer-facing program discovery. Captures program title, episode title, series name, genre, content rating (MPA), short and long synopsis, start/end time, channel, language, closed-caption flag, HDR/resolution flag, ISAN/EIDR identifier, and distribution window. Derived from approved schedule slots and enriched with content metadata for consumer-facing EPG feeds.

attributes.name: epg_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Electronic Program Guide (EPG) entry record in the scheduling domain. Serves as the primary key for this Silver Layer data product.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: availability_window_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rights.rights_availability_window. Business justification: EPG publication workflow requires real-time validation that content is within its rights availability window before displaying to viewers. Prevents publishing unavailable content and supports automate

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the broadcast channel on which this EPG entry is scheduled for playout. Links to the channel master record in the scheduling domain.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: compliance_content_rating_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.content_rating. Business justification: EPG displays must show accurate content ratings for viewer guidance, V-chip filtering, and watershed compliance. Regulatory requirement in UK (Ofcom) and US (FCC) for electronic program guides. Denorm

attributes.name: production_episode_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_episode. Business justification: EPG entries describe airing production episodes. Accurate EPG metadata (runtime, episode number, synopsis) must be sourced from the production episode record. This link enables automated EPG populatio

attributes.name: program_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.program_schedule. Business justification: An EPG entry is a published Electronic Program Guide record distributed to MVPDs and set-top boxes. EPG entries are generated from a specific program_schedule version (the authoritative linear channel

attributes.name: schedule_slot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved schedule slot from which this EPG entry was derived. Represents the authoritative playout scheduling record in Ericsson MediaFirst.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: scheduling_daypart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.daypart. Business justification: EPG entries require daypart linkage for audience reach estimation, program discovery optimization, and daypart-based content recommendations. Creates new scheduling_daypart_id FK (role-prefixed to avo

attributes.name: series_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.series. Business justification: EPG entries carry series_name as a denormalized plain column. Linking to content.series enables accurate series metadata in EPG feed syndication, supports series-level scheduling reports, and removes

attributes.name: version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.version. Business justification: EPG guide data must reflect the specific version being broadcast — HDR availability, language, closed caption status displayed to viewers. Version-level FK enables accurate capability flags in EPG fee

attributes.name: ad_pod_count
attributes.description: The number of ad pods (groups of advertisements within a break) scheduled within this program. Used for advertising inventory planning, Wide Orbit traffic scheduling, and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); SCTE-35

attributes.name: blackout_region_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of geographic region or market codes where this program is subject to broadcast blackout restrictions. Used by distribution systems to suppress EPG entry delivery in restricted markets. Populated only when is_blackout is True.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; FCC Blackout Rules 47 CFR Part 76

attributes.name: broadcast_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this program is scheduled to air, in yyyy-MM-dd format. Used for day-level EPG grid display, daypart assignment, and schedule reporting.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Externally distributed business identifier for this EPG entry, used in feeds delivered to MVPDs, vMVPDs, set-top boxes, and digital platforms for program discovery. Format: EPG-{CHANNEL}-{YYYYMMDD}-{HHMMSS}.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol; DVB SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: distribution_window
attributes.description: The distribution window or release strategy under which this EPG entry is being broadcast, reflecting the windowing strategy for sequential content release. Determines rights availability and platform eligibility per Rightsline contract terms.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; Motion Picture Association (MPA) Windowing Guidelines

attributes.name: duration_seconds
attributes.description: The total scheduled duration of the program in seconds, derived from the difference between scheduled start and end times. Used for EPG display, ad pod planning, and playout automation validation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SCTE-35

attributes.name: eidr
attributes.description: The Entertainment Identifier Registry (EIDR) identifier for this content, providing a universal content identifier used across the media supply chain for content tracking, rights management, and EPG data exchange with MVPDs and vMVPDs.
attributes.references: Entertainment Identifier Registry (EIDR) Association; Motion Picture Association (MPA)

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this EPG entry within the scheduling workflow. 'draft' indicates pending review; 'approved' indicates cleared for distribution; 'published' indicates actively distributed to EPG feeds; 'cancelled' indicates removed from schedule; 'expired' indicates the broadcast window has passed.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: epg_feed_version
attributes.description: The version number of this EPG entry record as distributed in the EPG feed. Incremented each time the entry is updated and redistributed to MVPDs, vMVPDs, and digital platforms. Enables downstream systems to detect and apply updates.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol; DVB SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: genre_primary
attributes.description: The primary content genre classification for this EPG entry as distributed in the EPG feed (e.g., Drama, Comedy, News, Sports, Documentary, Reality). Used for viewer discovery, content filtering, and audience analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: drama|comedy|news|sports|documentary|reality|entertainment|children|film|music — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DVB SI EN 300 468 Content Descriptor; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: genre_secondary
attributes.description: An optional secondary genre sub-classification providing more granular content categorization for EPG discovery and audience targeting (e.g., Crime Drama, Political Comedy, Investigative Documentary).

attributes.name: is_blackout
attributes.description: Indicates whether geographic broadcast restrictions (blackout) apply to this EPG entry (True). When True, the program is subject to blackout rules that restrict distribution in specific geographic markets per rights agreements managed in Rightsline.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; FCC Must-Carry and Blackout Rules 47 CFR Part 76

attributes.name: is_closed_caption
attributes.description: Indicates whether closed captioning (CC) is available for this program (True). Distributed in EPG feeds for accessibility compliance and viewer information. Required for FCC closed captioning regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 79 Closed Captioning; Twenty-First Century Communications and Video Accessibility Act (CVAA)

attributes.name: is_hdr
attributes.description: Indicates whether this program is available in High Dynamic Range (HDR) format (True). Distributed in EPG feeds to inform viewers and set-top boxes of enhanced picture quality availability.
attributes.references: ATSC A/341 High Dynamic Range; DVB HDR Specification

attributes.name: is_live
attributes.description: Indicates whether this EPG entry represents a live broadcast event (True) as opposed to a pre-recorded or time-shifted program (False). Drives playout automation configuration in Ericsson MediaFirst and is distributed in EPG feeds for viewer-facing live indicators.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: is_new_episode
attributes.description: Indicates whether this EPG entry represents a new, first-run episode (True) or a repeat/rerun broadcast (False). Distributed in EPG feeds for viewer-facing 'NEW' indicators and drives audience measurement prioritization.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: is_simulcast
attributes.description: Indicates whether this program is being simultaneously broadcast across multiple platforms or channels (simulcast). When True, the same content is distributed concurrently on linear and digital/OTT platforms.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: isan
attributes.description: The International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN) uniquely identifying this audiovisual work globally. Used for rights management, content identification across platforms, and interoperability with Rightsline and international content registries.
attributes.references: ISO 15706-2 International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN); ISAN International Agency

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: The primary audio language of the program, expressed as a three-letter ISO 639-2 language code (e.g., 'eng' for English, 'spa' for Spanish). Used in EPG feeds for language filtering and accessibility compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 639-2 Language Codes; ATSC A/65; DVB SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this EPG entry record was most recently modified, including schedule changes, metadata updates, or status transitions. Used for change detection in downstream EPG feed distribution and audit trail.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management

attributes.name: program_title
attributes.description: The primary viewer-facing title of the program as it appears in the Electronic Program Guide. Used for consumer-facing program discovery across all distribution platforms.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol; DVB SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this EPG entry was first published and distributed to external EPG feeds (MVPDs, vMVPDs, set-top boxes, digital platforms). Serves as the record audit created timestamp for this data product.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: rights_window_end
attributes.description: The end date of the broadcast rights window during which this content is cleared for transmission on this channel. After this date, the content enters a holdback period and cannot be broadcast without rights renewal in Rightsline.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; Motion Picture Association (MPA) Windowing Guidelines

attributes.name: rights_window_start
attributes.description: The start date of the broadcast rights window during which this content is cleared for transmission on this channel. Derived from Rightsline contract availabilities and used to validate schedule compliance.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; Motion Picture Association (MPA) Windowing Guidelines

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which this program is scheduled to end broadcast on the channel. Used to calculate program duration and to sequence adjacent EPG entries in the linear channel grid.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which this program is scheduled to begin broadcast on the channel, expressed in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. This is the principal business event timestamp for the EPG entry and drives all downstream playout automation in Ericsson MediaFirst.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65

attributes.name: scte35_cue_out_time
attributes.description: The timestamp of the SCTE-35 splice_insert cue-out signal marking the start of an ad break opportunity within this program. Used by Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) systems and Wide Orbit traffic systems for ad pod placement and automated ad scheduling.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message Standard; Society of Cable Telecommunications Engineers (SCTE)

attributes.name: synopsis_long
attributes.description: A detailed program description (typically up to 500 characters) distributed in EPG feeds for display on digital platforms, OTT apps, and web-based program guides. Sourced from Dalet Galaxy content metadata.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol; DVB SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: synopsis_short
attributes.description: A brief program description (typically up to 100 characters) distributed in EPG feeds for display on set-top boxes and digital platforms with limited screen real estate. Sourced from Dalet Galaxy content metadata.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol; DVB SI EN 300 468

attributes.name: total_ad_break_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The total cumulative duration in seconds of all scheduled ad breaks within this program. Used for advertising inventory management, compliance with ad load regulations, and Wide Orbit traffic scheduling.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; FCC Commercial Limits in Children's Programming; IAB

attributes.name: video_resolution
attributes.description: The video resolution format of this program as distributed in the EPG feed (e.g., SD, HD, FHD, UHD/4K). Used for viewer-facing display in EPG interfaces and for platform compatibility routing.
attributes.references: ATSC A/53 Digital Television Standard; DVB Digital Video Broadcasting Standards

products.name: ad_break
products.description: Commercial break (ad pod) within a schedule slot — capturing break position (pre-roll, mid-roll, post-roll), sequence number, planned and maximum pod duration, break type (local avail, network avail, promotional), SCTE-35 cue-in/cue-out marker references, DAI eligibility flag, and Wide Orbit traffic system break ID. The structural container for sellable ad inventory within the linear schedule, linking scheduling to advertising sales fulfillment.
products.reference: SCTE-35 Ad Pod / Wide Orbit Break

attributes.name: ad_break_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the ad break (ad pod) record within the scheduling domain. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: ad_billing_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.ad_billing_order. Business justification: Ad breaks are the inventory units sold in ad orders. Direct link required for order-to-inventory reconciliation, flight pacing analysis, and verifying contracted vs. delivered spots in advertising bil

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the broadcast channel on which this ad break is scheduled for playout. Supports multi-channel scheduling and channel-level inventory reporting.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: daypart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.daypart. Business justification: Ad break currently stores daypart_code as a STRING. This should be normalized to FK to the daypart reference table. Ad break pricing, GRP targets, and inventory management all depend on daypart attrib

attributes.name: political_ad_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.political_ad_record. Business justification: Political ad breaks require detailed public inspection file documentation per FCC Section 315 (reasonable access, lowest unit charge). Each political ad break must link to compliance record for public

attributes.name: program_schedule_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the SCTE-35 splice_insert or time_signal cue-out marker that signals the start of the ad break to downstream distribution systems and Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) platforms. References the specific SCTE-35 message that triggers break entry.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message Standard; SCTE Society of Cable Telecommunications Engineers

attributes.name: schedule_slot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent schedule slot within which this ad break is positioned. Links the ad break to its containing program or interstitial window in the linear channel grid.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: actual_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The actual total duration of the ad break as recorded during playout by the Ericsson MediaFirst automation system. Used for post-log reconciliation, affidavit generation, and makegood assessment when actual duration deviates from planned.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System (Affidavits)

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: The actual wall-clock time at which the ad break commenced during playout, as recorded by the Ericsson MediaFirst automation system. Used for affidavit generation and post-log reconciliation against the scheduled start time.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System (Affidavits)

attributes.name: affidavit_generated
attributes.description: Indicates whether a proof-of-broadcast affidavit has been generated for this ad break in the Wide Orbit traffic system following confirmed playout. Affidavits are required for advertiser billing reconciliation and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System (Affidavits); FCC Sponsorship Identification Rules

attributes.name: automation_event_code
attributes.description: The event identifier assigned by the Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation system to the break trigger event. Used to correlate the scheduled ad break with the actual playout automation log for post-log reconciliation and technical fault analysis.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: avail_count
attributes.description: The total number of individual advertising avail slots (unit positions) within this ad break pod. Each avail represents a discrete sellable unit (e.g., a 30-second spot position). Used for inventory capacity planning and traffic scheduling.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Advertising Standards

attributes.name: blackout_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ad break is subject to geographic blackout restrictions that prevent its broadcast or streaming in specific markets or regions. When true, downstream distribution systems must apply blackout logic per rights and regulatory obligations.
attributes.references: FCC Blackout Rules (47 CFR Part 76); Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management

attributes.name: break_position
attributes.description: Positional classification of the ad break relative to the surrounding program content. 'pre-roll' = before program content begins; 'mid-roll' = within program content; 'post-roll' = after program content ends; 'interstitial' = between programs in the schedule grid.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Standard

attributes.name: break_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ad break within the scheduling and playout workflow. 'scheduled' = planned but not yet confirmed; 'confirmed' = traffic-confirmed with sold inventory; 'aired' = playout completed and affidavit-eligible; 'cancelled' = removed from schedule; 'hold' = temporarily suspended pending resolution.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: break_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ad break by inventory ownership and commercial purpose. 'local_avail' = inventory sold by local affiliate; 'network_avail' = inventory sold by the network; 'promotional' = house promotional content; 'public_service' = public service announcements; 'emergency' = emergency alert system override. Drives revenue attribution and traffic scheduling rules.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; FCC Public Service Announcement Requirements

attributes.name: broadcast_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this ad break is scheduled to air, expressed in the channel's broadcast day convention (which may differ from the wall-clock date for late-night programming). Used for daily traffic scheduling, affidavit generation, and revenue reporting.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; FCC Affidavit Requirements

attributes.name: content_restriction_code
attributes.description: A code indicating any content category restrictions applicable to advertising within this break (e.g., no alcohol ads during children's programming, no competitor ads). Enforced by the traffic system during ad assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NO_ALCOHOL|NO_GAMBLING|NO_PHARMA|NO_COMPETITOR|CHILDREN_SAFE|NONE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FCC Children's Television Act (COPPA); Ofcom Broadcasting Code; MPA Content Rating Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ad break record was first created in the scheduling system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Data Integrity Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the rate card CPM and any monetary values associated with this ad break (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency operations for international broadcast networks.

attributes.name: dai_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ad break is enabled for Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI), allowing server-side ad replacement for OTT/streaming simulcast audiences. When true, the break is eligible for addressable advertising via DAI platforms such as those integrated with Akamai CDN.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST); SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Standard; Akamai CDN

attributes.name: epg_break_label
attributes.description: The human-readable label or descriptor for this ad break as it appears in the Electronic Program Guide (EPG) and scheduling rundown. Used by traffic coordinators and scheduling operators to identify breaks in the EPG interface.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol

attributes.name: grp_target
attributes.description: The target Gross Rating Point (GRP) value for this ad break, representing the expected total audience delivery as a percentage of the total target population. Used for audience guarantee tracking and campaign delivery reporting against Nielsen ratings.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: makegood_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a makegood (compensatory ad spot) is required for this break due to a failure to air as contracted — for example, due to preemption, technical failure, or underdelivery. Triggers makegood workflow in Wide Orbit.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Advertising Standards (Makegoods)

attributes.name: max_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The maximum allowable duration of the ad break in seconds, representing the hard ceiling for total ad content that may be inserted. Exceeding this value would cause schedule overrun. May differ from planned duration when flex time is permitted.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: nielsen_program_rating
attributes.description: The Nielsen audience rating for the program surrounding this ad break, representing the percentage of total TV households tuned in. Used for CPM calculation, audience guarantee assessment, and scatter market pricing.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; Nielsen Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: planned_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The planned total duration of the ad break (ad pod) in seconds as defined in the program schedule. Represents the total sellable commercial time allocated to this break. Standard pod durations are typically 30, 60, 90, 120, or 180 seconds.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: pod_number
attributes.description: The pod number identifying this ad break within the broadcast day for the channel. Distinct from sequence_number (which is relative to the program); pod_number is the channel-day-level ordinal used in traffic scheduling and affidavit reporting.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST)

attributes.name: preemption_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why this ad break was preempted or cancelled if it did not air as scheduled. Used for makegood processing, revenue assurance, and operational reporting. 'none' when the break aired as planned.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; FCC Emergency Alert System Rules

attributes.name: rate_card_cpm
attributes.description: The published rate card CPM (Cost Per Mille — cost per 1,000 audience impressions) for this ad break, expressed in the local currency. Represents the base pricing for inventory in this break before negotiated discounts. Used for revenue forecasting and yield management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Media Cloud Ad Sales; IAB CPM Pricing Standards

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The planned wall-clock date and time at which the ad break is scheduled to begin on the linear channel. Expressed in the channel's broadcast timezone. This is the principal BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for the break.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Standard

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this ad break within the parent schedule slot or program. Used to order multiple breaks within a single program (e.g., break 1, break 2, break 3) for traffic scheduling and playout automation.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: simulcast_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ad break is included in the simultaneous multi-platform broadcast (simulcast) of the channel. When false, the break may be suppressed or replaced on simulcast streams (e.g., OTT, vMVPD).
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST)

attributes.name: sold_avail_count
attributes.description: The number of individual avail slots within this break that have been sold and assigned to advertiser spots in the Wide Orbit traffic system. Used with avail_count to compute sellout rate and unsold inventory.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Salesforce Media Cloud Ad Sales

attributes.name: sold_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The total duration in seconds of ad inventory within this break that has been sold to advertisers via the Wide Orbit traffic system. Used to calculate unsold (remnant) inventory and sellout rate for revenue assurance reporting.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; Salesforce Media Cloud Ad Sales

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ad break record was most recently modified in the scheduling system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Data Integrity Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: wide_orbit_break_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Wide Orbit Traffic System Break ID
attributes.description: The externally-known break identifier assigned by the Wide Orbit traffic and billing system. Used to reconcile ad break inventory between the scheduling domain and the ad sales/traffic fulfillment workflow. This is the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for the break as known to the traffic system.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System

tag_set.value: Wide Orbit Traffic System Break ID

products.name: playout_event
products.description: As-run log record from Ericsson MediaFirst capturing actual transmission of each schedule slot as broadcast. Records actual start/end time, duration, content ID, channel, playout status (aired, skipped, substituted, failed), automation mode (auto, manual, override), operator ID, and deviation from planned schedule in seconds. The authoritative as-run record serving as the evidentiary basis for affidavit generation, rights usage reporting, advertiser billing reconciliation, and regulatory proof-of-performance.

attributes.name: playout_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each as-run playout event record in the Ericsson MediaFirst as-run log. Serves as the primary key for this table.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: ad_billing_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.ad_billing_order. Business justification: Playout events represent actual aired content that must be reconciled against ad billing orders for affidavit generation, makegood determination, and revenue recognition. Critical for verifying contra

attributes.name: ad_pod_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the advertising pod (Ad Pod) to which this playout event belongs, if the event is a commercial break or advertisement. Links to the Wide Orbit ad scheduling record for billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Ad Pod Standards

attributes.name: broadcast_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.broadcast_license. Business justification: Playout events incur transmission and playout automation costs. Transmission cost allocation, actual-vs-budget variance analysis, and operational cost accounting require event-to-cost-center mapping.

attributes.name: channel_id

attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: closed_caption_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.closed_caption_record. Business justification: Each playout event must have corresponding closed caption compliance record for FCC CVAA accessibility reporting. Required for quarterly closed captioning quality reports and complaint response. Links

attributes.name: daypart_id
