attributes.name: deliverable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.deliverable. Business justification: A playout event plays out a specific deliverable asset. Operations teams verify the deliverable's checksum, QC pass flag, and technical specs at playout. This link enables as-run reconciliation agains

attributes.name: grant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rights.grant. Business justification: As-run logs require grant tracking for royalty calculation, rights holder reporting, and usage reconciliation. Post-broadcast process matches actual airings to grants for residual payments and revenue

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Wide Orbit affidavit document generated for this playout event. Populated when affidavit_generated is true. Used for advertiser billing reconciliation and regulatory proof-of-performance.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; FCC Proof-of-Performance Requirements

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Events transmitted via specific equipment - required for technical affidavits, equipment performance tracking, and playout automation diagnostics. Supports as-run reconciliation and equipment maintena

attributes.name: primary_playout_title_id
attributes.description: Reference to the content asset (programme, advertisement, interstitial, or filler) that was transmitted in this playout event. Links to the content master in the Digital Asset Management system.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management; EIDR (Entertainment Identifier Registry)

attributes.name: production_episode_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.production_episode. Business justification: A playout event airs a specific production episode. As-run logs, residuals calculation, and rights clearance verification all require linking the playout event to the production episode. This is a fun

attributes.name: program_rundown_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.program_rundown. Business justification: A playout_event is the as-run log from Ericsson MediaFirst capturing actual transmission. For live and studio programs, the playout_event corresponds to a specific program_rundown that was executed. T

attributes.name: program_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the planned program schedule entry from which this playout event was derived. Enables deviation analysis between planned and actual transmission.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; scheduling.program_schedule

attributes.name: schedule_slot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.schedule_slot. Business justification: Playout events are as-run logs capturing actual transmission of schedule slots. Currently playout_event links to program_schedule but not to the specific schedule_slot that was transmitted. This FK en

attributes.name: version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.version. Business justification: Post-transmission audit and rights compliance verification require knowing which technical version was actually transmitted. Version-territory matching for rights clearance and QC reconciliation betwe

attributes.name: actual_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Actual transmitted duration of the playout event in seconds as recorded in the as-run log. Used for rights usage reporting, billing reconciliation, and compliance verification.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management

attributes.name: actual_end_time
attributes.description: Actual transmission end time as recorded in the Ericsson MediaFirst as-run log. Used with actual_start_time to confirm full transmission and calculate actual duration.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; FCC Proof-of-Performance Requirements

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: Actual transmission start time as recorded in the Ericsson MediaFirst as-run log. The authoritative timestamp for affidavit generation, rights usage reporting, and regulatory proof-of-performance.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; FCC Proof-of-Performance Requirements

attributes.name: affidavit_generated
attributes.description: Indicates whether a broadcast affidavit (proof-of-performance document) has been generated for this playout event in Wide Orbit. Affidavits are the evidentiary basis for advertiser billing and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; FCC Proof-of-Performance Requirements

attributes.name: automation_mode
attributes.description: Operational mode of the Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation at the time of this event. 'auto' = fully automated playout; 'manual' = operator-controlled; 'override' = scheduled automation overridden by operator; 'failover' = backup/failover system active.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: blackout_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this playout event was subject to a geographic broadcast blackout restriction. When true, the event was blacked out in one or more markets per rights or regulatory obligations.
attributes.references: FCC Blackout Rules; Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management

attributes.name: broadcast_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this playout event was transmitted, expressed in the channel's local broadcast day (which may differ from UTC date for overnight programming).
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC Standards

attributes.name: broadcast_standard
attributes.description: Technical broadcast standard under which this playout event was transmitted. Determines encoding, modulation, and compliance requirements.
attributes.references: ATSC (Advanced Television Systems Committee) Standards; DVB Project (Digital Video Broadcasting) Standards; ISO/IEC 14496 MPEG-4

attributes.name: content_rating
attributes.description: Content rating classification of the transmitted asset as defined by the Motion Picture Association (MPA) TV Parental Guidelines. Used for COPPA compliance, watershed enforcement, and FCC children's programming obligations.
attributes.references: Motion Picture Association (MPA) TV Parental Guidelines; FCC Children's Television Act; COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this as-run playout event record was first ingested into the Silver layer from the Ericsson MediaFirst as-run log. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Requirements

attributes.name: dai_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this playout event was eligible for Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) on OTT/streaming platforms. Used for digital advertising reconciliation and DAI revenue attribution.
attributes.references: IAB DAI (Dynamic Ad Insertion) Standards; SCTE-35 Standard

attributes.name: dalet_asset_code
attributes.description: Asset identifier in the Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management system for the content transmitted in this playout event. Used for digital asset reconciliation and archive linkage.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management and Workflow Orchestration

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the playout event by content category. Determines applicable rights, billing rules, and regulatory requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: program|commercial|promo|interstitial|filler|ident|emergency_alert — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SCTE Standards; IAB Digital Advertising Standards

attributes.name: failover_activated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Ericsson MediaFirst failover/backup playout system was active during this event. When true, the primary playout chain was unavailable and the backup system handled transmission.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: isan_code
attributes.description: International Standard Audiovisual Number (ISAN) identifying the programme or content asset transmitted. Used for rights usage reporting and royalty calculation in Rightsline.
attributes.references: ISAN (International Standard Audiovisual Number) ISO 15706; Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management

attributes.name: isci_code
attributes.description: Industry Standard Commercial Identification (ISCI) code for the commercial asset transmitted in this playout event. Used for advertiser billing reconciliation and affidavit generation in Wide Orbit.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; ISCI (Industry Standard Commercial Identification) Standard

attributes.name: mediafirst_event_code
attributes.description: Native event identifier assigned by Ericsson MediaFirst automation system for this as-run log entry. Used for reconciliation with the source playout system.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: must_carry_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this playout event was subject to must-carry obligations requiring mandatory channel inclusion by MVPDs. Used for regulatory compliance reporting to the FCC.
attributes.references: FCC Must-Carry Rules (47 CFR Part 76); MVPD (Multichannel Video Programming Distributor) Regulations

attributes.name: playout_status
attributes.description: Outcome status of the playout event as recorded in the Ericsson MediaFirst as-run log. 'aired' = transmitted as planned; 'skipped' = omitted from transmission; 'substituted' = replaced with alternate content; 'failed' = transmission error; 'partial' = incomplete transmission; 'delayed' = transmitted late.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; FCC Proof-of-Performance Requirements

attributes.name: rights_clearance_status
attributes.description: Rights clearance status of the content asset at the time of transmission. 'cleared' = rights verified and valid; 'pending' = clearance in progress; 'expired' = rights window had lapsed; 'restricted' = transmission was restricted. Used for rights compliance audit and Rightsline reconciliation.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; FCC Compliance

attributes.name: scheduled_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Planned duration of the playout event in seconds as defined in the program schedule rundown. Used as the baseline for duration deviation analysis.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Planned transmission start time for this event as defined in the Electronic Program Guide (EPG) and program schedule rundown. Used as the baseline for schedule deviation calculation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; EPG (Electronic Program Guide) Standards

attributes.name: simulcast_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this playout event was simultaneously broadcast across multiple platforms (simulcast). When true, the event was transmitted on additional channels or OTT platforms concurrently.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC Standards

attributes.name: start_deviation_seconds
attributes.description: Difference in seconds between actual_start_time and scheduled_start_time. Positive values indicate late start; negative values indicate early start. Key metric for schedule adherence and SLA reporting.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SLA (Service Level Agreement) Standards

attributes.name: substitution_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the originally scheduled content was substituted with alternate content. Populated only when playout_status is 'substituted'. Used for rights compliance and editorial audit trails.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; FCC Compliance

attributes.name: transmission_type
attributes.description: Mode of content delivery for this playout event. 'linear' = traditional scheduled broadcast; 'vod' = Video On Demand; 'simulcast' = simultaneous multi-platform; 'ott' = Over-The-Top streaming; 'fast' = Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC Standards; DVB Project Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this playout event record was last modified in the Silver layer, for example following affidavit generation, rights clearance update, or schedule reconciliation.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Requirements

attributes.name: wide_orbit_log_code
attributes.description: Corresponding log entry identifier in Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing system. Used for advertiser billing reconciliation and affidavit generation.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System

products.name: program_rundown
products.description: Detailed production rundown for a live or studio program defining the internal segment structure — news blocks, interview segments, commercial breaks, toss segments, and closing credits. Captures program title, episode reference, total runtime, segment count, live/tape flag, rundown status, and the ordered list of rundown items with planned durations. Used by Ericsson MediaFirst automation for live show playout control and by production teams for show preparation.

attributes.name: program_rundown_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the program rundown record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the broadcast channel on which this program rundown is executed. Links to the channel master in the scheduling domain.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: content_episode_id
attributes.description: Reference to the episode or content asset in the content domain that this rundown is associated with. Enables linkage to content metadata, rights, and digital asset records.

attributes.name: daypart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.daypart. Business justification: Program rundown currently stores daypart_code as a STRING. This should be normalized to FK to the daypart reference table (scheduling_daypart_id). This enables JOIN to retrieve daypart_name, rate_mult

attributes.name: grant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rights.grant. Business justification: Live production rundowns need real-time rights clearance verification per segment. Control room operators validate grant coverage during live broadcasts to prevent on-air rights violations, especially

attributes.name: program_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent program schedule entry (Electronic Program Guide slot) that this rundown fulfills. Aligns with scheduling.program_schedule.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: schedule_slot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.schedule_slot. Business justification: A program_rundown is the detailed production rundown for a live or studio program that occupies a specific schedule_slot. The schedule_slot is the parent broadcast event; the program_rundown is the op

attributes.name: version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.version. Business justification: Rundowns drive playout automation and must reference the specific content version for technical parameter configuration. The dalet_story_code plain column suggests version-level asset referencing; a p

attributes.name: ad_pod_count
attributes.description: Number of commercial break ad pods (groups of ads) planned within this rundown. Used for Wide Orbit traffic scheduling and SCTE-35 cue marker planning.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Advertising Standards; SCTE-35; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the producer or scheduling manager who approved the final rundown for transmission. Required for production accountability and compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the rundown was formally approved for playout. Marks the transition from 'approved' to 'locked' status in the production workflow.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: blackout_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether geographic broadcast blackout restrictions apply to this program rundown. When True, blackout rules must be enforced by distribution systems per rights agreements managed in Rightsline.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; FCC Blackout Rules

attributes.name: broadcast_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this program rundown is scheduled for transmission. Used for EPG alignment, scheduling compliance, and as-run reconciliation.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Licensing; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout

attributes.name: content_rating
attributes.description: The TV Parental Guidelines content rating assigned to the program (e.g., TV-G, TV-14, TV-MA). Used for scheduling compliance, COPPA restrictions, and EPG display.
attributes.references: FCC Children's Television Act; TV Parental Guidelines; COPPA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rundown record was first created in the system, typically when the production team initiates show preparation in Dalet Galaxy.

attributes.name: dai_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this program rundown is eligible for Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) on streaming/OTT platforms. Drives ad tech configuration in Akamai CDN and Adobe Experience Platform.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Advertising Standards; Akamai CDN

attributes.name: dalet_story_code
attributes.description: The story or rundown identifier in Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management system. Enables traceability from the Silver Layer back to the MAM workflow for metadata, archive, and ingest operations.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management and Workflow Orchestration

attributes.name: emergency_alert_ready
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rundown and playout configuration supports Emergency Alert System (EAS) interruption. Required for FCC broadcast compliance and emergency preparedness.
attributes.references: FCC Emergency Alert System Rules; ATSC Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rundown record was last updated. Tracks the most recent editorial or operational change to the rundown for audit and version control purposes.

attributes.name: live_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the program is transmitted live (True) or is a pre-recorded/tape playback (False). Drives Ericsson MediaFirst live playout mode and affects DAI eligibility and failover configuration.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: mediafirst_rundown_code
attributes.description: The native rundown identifier assigned by Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation system. Used for bidirectional reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the operational playout system.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: playout_failover_mode
attributes.description: Defines the failover strategy configured in Ericsson MediaFirst if the primary playout source fails during this program. 'none' = no failover; 'backup_channel' = switch to backup feed; 'filler_loop' = play filler content; 'manual' = operator intervention required.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC Standards

attributes.name: production_format
attributes.description: Describes the production origination format of the program. 'studio' = produced in-house studio; 'remote' = outside broadcast; 'hybrid' = mixed studio and remote; 'tape' = pre-recorded playback; 'simulcast' = simultaneous multi-platform broadcast.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: program_content_seconds
attributes.description: Total planned duration of editorial/program content segments in seconds, excluding commercial breaks and credits. Used for content-to-ad ratio compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FCC Children's Television Act; Ofcom Broadcasting Code

attributes.name: program_title
attributes.description: The editorial title of the program for which this rundown is prepared (e.g., 'Morning News Live', 'Prime Time Sports'). Used for display in production systems and EPG.

attributes.name: rights_clearance_status
attributes.description: Current rights clearance status for the program content in this rundown. 'cleared' = all rights verified for broadcast; 'pending' = clearance in progress; 'restricted' = broadcast blocked; 'expired' = rights window has lapsed. Sourced from Rightsline.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; Motion Picture Association

attributes.name: rundown_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the rundown, used by production teams and Ericsson MediaFirst automation to reference the show rundown. Unique within a broadcast date and channel.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: rundown_notes
attributes.description: Free-text production notes associated with the rundown, capturing special instructions, last-minute changes, talent notes, or technical advisories for the production and playout teams.

attributes.name: rundown_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rundown. 'draft' = in preparation; 'approved' = signed off by producer; 'locked' = no further edits permitted; 'transmitted' = playout completed; 'archived' = retained for compliance.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: rundown_type
attributes.description: Classification of the program rundown by genre or production format. Drives template selection in Ericsson MediaFirst and informs segment structure expectations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: news|sports|entertainment|talk_show|documentary|magazine|special — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: rundown_version
attributes.description: Incremental version number of the rundown, incremented each time the rundown is revised. Enables version tracking and rollback for production teams and playout automation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: The planned transmission end timestamp for the program. Used to calculate total runtime and validate against EPG slot allocation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC Standards

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The planned transmission start timestamp for the program, including timezone offset. Used by Ericsson MediaFirst automation for playout triggering and EPG publication.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC Standards

attributes.name: scte35_cue_count
attributes.description: Number of SCTE-35 digital program insertion cue markers planned in this rundown. Used for Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) triggering and ad break signaling to downstream distribution systems.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message Standard; IAB DAI Standards

attributes.name: segment_count
attributes.description: Total number of rundown items (segments) defined in this rundown, including news blocks, interviews, commercial breaks, tosses, and credits. Used for production planning and playout validation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: simulcast_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this program rundown is simultaneously broadcast across multiple platforms (linear, OTT, streaming). When True, simulcast platform configurations must be applied.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; DVB Project Standards

attributes.name: total_ad_time_seconds
attributes.description: Total planned advertising time in seconds across all ad pods in the rundown. Used for FCC/Ofcom advertising minutage compliance and Wide Orbit traffic reconciliation.
attributes.references: FCC Broadcast Licensing; Ofcom Broadcasting Code; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing

attributes.name: total_runtime_seconds
attributes.description: Total planned duration of the program in seconds, encompassing all segments including program content, commercial breaks, and credits. Must match the EPG slot allocation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: transmitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time when playout of this program rundown commenced transmission. Populated by Ericsson MediaFirst upon broadcast start. Used for as-run reconciliation and affidavit generation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Wide Orbit Affidavit

attributes.name: wide_orbit_log_code
attributes.description: The traffic log identifier in Wide Orbit used to reconcile ad pod placements in this rundown against the ad scheduling and billing system. Supports affidavit generation and as-run confirmation.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System

products.name: rundown_item
products.description: Individual segment or item within a program rundown, representing a discrete production element (story package, live shot, interview, commercial break, graphic, music bed, or filler). Captures item sequence, item type, planned duration, actual duration, content asset reference, presenter/anchor assignment, cue text, backtime flag, and item status (ready, on-air, completed, skipped). The atomic unit of live show production control.
products.reference: Ericsson MediaFirst Rundown Item / iNews Story

attributes.name: rundown_item_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual segment or item within a program rundown. Primary key for the rundown_item entity in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management

attributes.name: ad_break_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.ad_break. Business justification: A rundown_item can represent an ad pod within a live program rundown (ad_pod_flag: BOOLEAN, ad_pod_duration_seconds: INT, ad_pod_spot_count: INT). When a rundown_item is an ad pod, it corresponds to a

attributes.name: content_episode_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.content_episode. Business justification: Individual rundown items represent specific episode segments for broadcast. Episode-level linking enables segment-level rights clearance verification, music cue sheet tracking per item, and accurate b

attributes.name: deliverable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to production.deliverable. Business justification: Each rundown item references a specific production deliverable (video package, VO, pre-produced segment) that will be played out. Traffic and operations teams use this link to verify the deliverable's

attributes.name: program_rundown_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.program_rundown. Business justification: Rundown items are individual segments within a program rundown. Currently rundown_item only links to program_schedule, but it should also link to the specific program_rundown that contains it. This pr

attributes.name: program_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent program schedule (rundown header) that this item belongs to. Links the atomic rundown item to its containing broadcast schedule.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; scheduling.program_schedule

attributes.name: role_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to talent.role. Business justification: Individual rundown segments must track which role is active for script cues, graphics templates, segment-level credit attribution, and scene-specific production notes. Enables granular production coor

attributes.name: talent_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to talent.talent_profile. Business justification: Individual rundown segments feature specific talent (correspondents, panelists, guests) requiring tracking for segment-level screen time calculation, residual eligibility determination, and credit att

attributes.name: version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.version. Business justification: Each rundown item references a specific content version for playout automation. The dalet_asset_code plain column on rundown_item is a denormalized version reference; a proper FK enables automated pre

attributes.name: actual_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Real elapsed duration of the rundown item in seconds as recorded during or after playout. Compared against planned_duration_seconds for show timing analysis and as-run log reconciliation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing Affidavit

attributes.name: actual_end_time
attributes.description: Actual wall-clock time at which this rundown item completed playout. Used alongside actual_start_time to compute actual_duration_seconds and to validate show overrun or underrun conditions.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing Affidavit

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: Actual wall-clock time at which this rundown item began playout as recorded by the Ericsson MediaFirst automation system. Used for as-run log generation and Wide Orbit affidavit reconciliation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing Affidavit

attributes.name: ad_pod_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total allocated duration in seconds for the ad pod break associated with this rundown item. Populated only when ad_pod_flag is true. Used for ad load compliance and Wide Orbit traffic scheduling.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Interactive Advertising Bureau; FCC broadcast advertising regulations

attributes.name: ad_pod_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rundown item represents an Ad Pod (a group of commercial spots within a break). When true, triggers SCTE-35 cue marker insertion and Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) eligibility checks.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message; IAB Interactive Advertising Bureau; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing

attributes.name: ad_pod_spot_count
attributes.description: Number of individual commercial spots scheduled within this ad pod break. Used for ad load monitoring, Wide Orbit traffic log validation, and FCC children's programming ad limit compliance.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; FCC Children's Television Act ad limit regulations; IAB

attributes.name: backtime_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rundown item is backtimed — i.e., its start time is calculated backwards from a fixed end point (e.g., top-of-hour news break or programme end). Critical for live show timing control in Ericsson MediaFirst.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC Advanced Television Systems Committee

attributes.name: blackout_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether geographic broadcast blackout restrictions apply to this rundown item. When true, triggers blackout enforcement logic in the distribution layer per rights agreements managed in Rightsline.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; FCC Blackout Rules; Ofcom Broadcasting Standards

attributes.name: content_rating
attributes.description: Motion Picture Association (MPA) or TV Parental Guidelines content rating applicable to this rundown item. Used for COPPA compliance checks, watershed scheduling enforcement, and EPG advisory display.
attributes.references: Motion Picture Association (MPA) Content Ratings; FCC V-Chip and TV Parental Guidelines; COPPA Children's Online Privacy Protection Act

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rundown item record was first created in the data platform, typically corresponding to the initial rundown build in Dalet Galaxy or Ericsson MediaFirst. Supports audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: cue_text
attributes.description: Editorial cue or introduction text read by the presenter or director to introduce this rundown item. Stored as the production script reference for live show execution and post-broadcast archive.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: dalet_asset_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the content asset in Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management system associated with this rundown item. Links the production element to its archived media essence, metadata, and workflow history.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management and Workflow Orchestration

attributes.name: daypart_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the broadcast daypart (time segment of the broadcast day) in which this rundown item falls. Links to scheduling.daypart for rate multiplier, demographic targeting, and Nielsen audience measurement context.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Daypart Definitions; scheduling.daypart; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing

attributes.name: duration_variance_seconds
attributes.description: Difference in seconds between actual_duration_seconds and planned_duration_seconds (actual minus planned). Positive values indicate overrun; negative values indicate underrun. Used for show timing analysis and rundown optimisation.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing Affidavit

attributes.name: eom_timecode
attributes.description: SMPTE timecode marking the End of Message (EOM) — the precise out-point of the media asset for this rundown item. Used alongside som_timecode for frame-accurate duration calculation and playout control.
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 12-1 Timecode Standard; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Dalet Galaxy MAM

attributes.name: epg_description
attributes.description: Short editorial description of this rundown item for display in the Electronic Program Guide (EPG). Populated for story packages and feature segments; used by EPG aggregators and on-screen guide systems.
attributes.references: ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol (PSIP); DVB SI Digital Video Broadcasting Service Information

attributes.name: graphics_template_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the graphics or lower-third template to be rendered by the Ericsson MediaFirst graphics engine for this rundown item. Applicable for graphic and lower_third segment formats.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management Graphics Module

attributes.name: isci_code
attributes.description: Industry Standard Commercial Identification (ISCI) code for the commercial spot associated with this rundown item. Populated for commercial_break items; used for Wide Orbit affidavit generation and advertiser billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: ISCI Industry Standard Commercial Identification; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Interactive Advertising Bureau

attributes.name: item_status
attributes.description: Current production lifecycle state of the rundown item as managed in the live show production control system. Drives automation decisions in Ericsson MediaFirst and Dalet Galaxy workflow.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management

attributes.name: item_title
attributes.description: Human-readable editorial title or slug for the rundown item as displayed in the production control system and Electronic Program Guide (EPG). Used by producers and directors during live show execution.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management; ATSC A/76 Programming Identification and Label Guide

attributes.name: item_type
attributes.description: Classification of the discrete production element represented by this rundown item. Determines playout behaviour, automation triggers, and ad pod eligibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: story_package|live_shot|interview|commercial_break|graphic|music_bed|filler|open|close — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Dalet Galaxy Workflow Orchestration

attributes.name: live_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rundown item is a live production element (true) or a pre-recorded/packaged asset (false). Drives Ericsson MediaFirst automation mode selection and EPG live indicator display.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol

attributes.name: mediafirst_item_code
attributes.description: Native item identifier assigned by the Ericsson MediaFirst playout automation system for this rundown element. Used for reconciliation between the Silver Layer data product and the operational playout system.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management

attributes.name: planned_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Scheduled duration of the rundown item in seconds as defined during pre-production rundown preparation. Used for total show timing, backtime calculations, and ad pod compliance checks.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; SCTE Society of Cable Telecommunications Engineers

attributes.name: planned_start_time
attributes.description: Scheduled wall-clock start time for this rundown item based on the pre-production rundown. Used for Electronic Program Guide (EPG) display, backtime calculations, and SCTE-35 cue marker pre-positioning.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC A/65 Program and System Information Protocol

attributes.name: rights_clearance_status
attributes.description: Current rights clearance state for the content asset associated with this rundown item as verified against Rightsline. Prevents playout of uncleared content and supports compliance with windowing and holdback obligations.
attributes.references: Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; Motion Picture Association (MPA); FCC broadcast licensing

attributes.name: scte35_cue_in_time
attributes.description: Timestamp at which the SCTE-35 splice_insert cue-in signal is triggered to mark the return to programme content after an ad break. Used for DAI reconciliation and ad delivery verification.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message for Cable and Satellite; ATSC Advanced Television Systems Committee

attributes.name: scte35_cue_out_time
attributes.description: Timestamp at which the SCTE-35 splice_insert cue-out signal is triggered to mark the start of an ad break for Dynamic Ad Insertion (DAI) and addressable advertising systems. Populated for commercial_break item types.
attributes.references: SCTE-35 Digital Program Insertion Cueing Message for Cable and Satellite; ATSC Advanced Television Systems Committee

attributes.name: segment_format
attributes.description: Production format classification of the rundown item using broadcast newsroom terminology. Determines the technical playout configuration and graphics overlay requirements in Ericsson MediaFirst. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pkg|vo|vosot|sot|live|standup|anchor_read|graphic_full|lower_third — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Dalet Galaxy Workflow Orchestration

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this item within the program rundown, determining the playout order. Used by Ericsson MediaFirst automation to sequence segments during live show production control.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; ATSC Advanced Television Systems Committee

attributes.name: simulcast_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rundown item is simultaneously broadcast across multiple platforms (linear, OTT, streaming). When true, triggers multi-platform distribution workflows and DAI configuration in Akamai CDN.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Akamai CDN Streaming; DVB Digital Video Broadcasting

attributes.name: skip_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why this rundown item was skipped during playout. Populated only when item_status = skipped. Used for post-broadcast editorial review and rights compliance audit.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Rightsline Rights and Royalties Management; FCC broadcast compliance

attributes.name: som_timecode
attributes.description: SMPTE timecode marking the Start of Message (SOM) — the precise in-point of the media asset to be played for this rundown item. Used by Ericsson MediaFirst for frame-accurate playout cueing.
attributes.references: SMPTE ST 12-1 Timecode Standard; Ericsson MediaFirst Playout and Channel Management; Dalet Galaxy MAM

attributes.name: tape_number
attributes.description: Physical or virtual media identifier (tape ID, clip ID, or server ID) for the pre-recorded asset associated with this rundown item in the Dalet Galaxy MAM system. Used for media retrieval and playout server cueing.
attributes.references: Dalet Galaxy Media Asset Management; SMPTE Society of Motion Picture and Television Engineers

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this rundown item record. Tracks editorial changes, status transitions, and timing adjustments throughout the show production lifecycle.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: wide_orbit_spot_code
attributes.description: Identifier from the Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing system for commercial spots or ad pod items within this rundown. Populated only for item_type = commercial_break; used for affidavit generation and billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Interactive Advertising Bureau

domains.name: distribution
domains.description: Governs multi-platform content delivery across linear broadcast (DVB, ATSC, QAM), OTT streaming (HLS, MPEG-DASH, ABR), MVPD/vMVPD carriage, FAST channel syndication, and OTT platform infrastructure. Manages CDN configuration, DRM enforcement, DAI, streaming endpoints, ABR profiles, device support, QoS monitoring, and all delivery SLAs.

products.name: ott_platform
products.description: Master registry of all OTT service platforms operated by Media Broadcasting — web, mobile, connected TV (CTV), and set-top box (STB). Captures platform identity, service tier (SVOD, AVOD, TVOD, FAST), launch date, supported protocols (HLS, MPEG-DASH), DRM system bindings, CDN provider assignments, geographic availability, regulatory jurisdiction, brand identity, and operational status. This is the SSOT anchor for the entire platform domain — all other platform products reference back to this entity.

attributes.name: ott_platform_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each OTT service platform record in the master registry. Primary key for the ott_platform entity — all downstream distribution products reference this key.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards

attributes.name: accessibility_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.accessibility_obligation. Business justification: OTT platforms have platform-wide accessibility obligations (UI accessibility, player controls, caption support). Compliance tracking and regulatory reporting require linking platforms to their specifi

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.account. Business justification: OTT platforms require billing account linkage for subscription billing setup, revenue recognition by platform, and financial reporting. Media broadcasting operations track platform-level billing confi

attributes.name: billing_cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.cycle. Business justification: OTT platforms operate on defined subscription billing cycles (monthly, annual) that govern when subscriber invoices are generated. Linking ott_platform to billing.cycle enables platform-level billing

attributes.name: broadcast_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.broadcast_license. Business justification: OTT platforms retransmitting broadcast content operate under specific broadcast licenses. Retransmission consent agreements and carriage rights require tracking which license authorizes the platform's

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to rights.territory. Business justification: OTT platforms operate in specific territories with distinct regulatory, content rating, and rights enforcement requirements. Replaces geographic_availability text with structured territory reference.

attributes.name: adobe_property_code
attributes.description: The unique property identifier assigned to this OTT platform within Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) for audience data collection, segmentation, and personalization. Used to link platform-level engagement events to subscriber profiles and Nielsen cross-platform measurement.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform; IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: arpu
attributes.description: Average monthly revenue generated per active subscriber on this platform, expressed in the platform's billing currency. Calculated at the platform level for strategic pricing and investor reporting. Confidential as a key financial performance indicator. Sourced from Zuora revenue recognition data.
attributes.references: Zuora Subscription Billing and Revenue; SOX Financial Reporting; EBITDA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: base_subscription_price
attributes.description: The standard monthly subscription price for this platform in the billing currency. Applicable for SVOD and HYBRID tiers. Null for AVOD and FAST platforms with no subscription fee. Used in Zuora plan configuration and financial forecasting in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Zuora Subscription Billing and Revenue; SAP S/4HANA CO; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: billing_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the primary billing currency used on this platform (e.g., 'USD', 'GBP', 'EUR'). Governs Zuora subscription plan pricing, SAP S/4HANA financial reconciliation, and multi-currency revenue reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SOX Financial Reporting; Zuora Subscription Billing and Revenue; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: cdn_origin_url
attributes.description: The base origin URL configured in the CDN for this platform's content delivery. Used by Akamai CDN to route requests to the correct media origin server. Critical for CDN configuration audits and incident troubleshooting.
attributes.references: Akamai CDN Configuration Standards; SCTE Standards

attributes.name: cdn_provider
attributes.description: The primary CDN provider contracted to deliver streaming content for this OTT platform. Drives SLA monitoring, peering agreements, and cost allocation. 'Multi-CDN' indicates a load-balanced or failover configuration across multiple providers. Maps to Akamai CDN platform configuration records.
attributes.references: Akamai CDN SLA; SCTE Standards; IAB Tech Lab Digital Video Standards

attributes.name: content_rating_system
attributes.description: The content classification and rating system applied to content on this platform (e.g., MPAA for USA, BBFC for UK, FSK for Germany). Governs parental control enforcement, COPPA compliance for children's content, and MPA anti-piracy obligations.
attributes.references: Motion Picture Association (MPA) Content Ratings; COPPA; Ofcom Broadcasting Standards; FCC Broadcast Licensing

attributes.name: coppa_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this platform is designated as COPPA-compliant, meaning it is directed at children under 13 and adheres to COPPA data collection restrictions. domains.name: rights

products.name: license_agreement
products.description: Master record for all content licensing, acquisition, and syndication agreements managed in Rightsline. Captures the full contractual relationship between Media Broadcasting and rights grantors or licensees (studios, distributors, music publishers, talent guilds, syndication partners). Stores agreement type (acquisition, co-production, syndication, first-run syndication, off-network syndication, international syndication, music sync, output deal), licensor and licensee identities, effective and expiry dates, territory scope, exclusivity flags, total license fee, payment schedule with milestone detail (advances, minimum guarantees, per-episode fees, annual installments), run count limitations for syndication, governing law jurisdiction, and agreement status (draft, executed, expired, terminated). This is the SSOT for all rights-bearing contracts and the anchor entity for all downstream window, royalty, and clearance records.

products.name: content_window
products.description: Defines the sequential release window strategy (windowing) for a specific content asset across exploitation platforms, and computes the net availability status. Each record captures the window type (theatrical, PVOD, TVOD, SVOD, AVOD, linear, FAST, home video, syndication), platform or channel scope, window open and close dates, holdback start and end dates, territory, exclusivity tier, and computed availability status (available, held-back, blacked-out, expired). Enforces the windowing hierarchy that prevents simultaneous exploitation across competing platforms. The net availability (considering holdbacks and blackouts) is refreshed whenever upstream rights or holdback records change. Directly consumed by scheduling and distribution domains to validate playout eligibility. Powered by Rightsline Windows module.

products.name: holdback
products.description: Records exclusivity holdback restrictions that prevent a content asset from being exploited on a specific platform, territory, or channel during a defined period. Each holdback captures the restriction type (platform holdback, territory holdback, channel holdback, format holdback), the restricted platform or distributor, holdback start and end dates, the triggering window type and source window reference, the source license agreement, and enforcement status (active, expired, waived, overridden). Holdbacks are enforced by the clearance workflow before any scheduling or distribution action is approved. Critical for MVPD carriage negotiations, OTT windowing compliance, and theatrical-to-home-video sequencing. Links to rights_content_window and license_agreement.

products.name: territory
products.description: Reference master for geographic territories and territory groups used in rights grants, holdbacks, and royalty calculations. Each record defines a territory by ISO country code, territory name, territory group (e.g., EMEA, LATAM, North America, Worldwide), broadcast regulatory body (FCC, Ofcom, etc.), currency, and whether the territory is subject to blackout restrictions. Provides the standardized territory taxonomy consumed by all rights, scheduling, and distribution products.

domains.name: subscriber
domains.description: SSOT for all subscriber and membership identities across SVOD, AVOD, TVOD, and bundled service tiers. Manages subscriber profiles, household linkage, plan enrollment, authentication credentials, device registrations, viewing entitlements, parental controls, churn tracking, and ARPU/LTV metrics. Integrates with Zuora for subscription billing and Adobe Experience Platform for personalization. Enforces GDPR, CCPA, and COPPA compliance for subscriber data.

products.name: subscriber
products.description: Master identity record for every subscriber across SVOD, AVOD, TVOD, and bundled service tiers. Each subscriber has a unique identity independent of household or device.

attributes.description: The date when the subscriber disabled auto-renewal for their subscription. Null if auto-renewal was never disabled. Used to identify planned churn versus reactive churn.

attributes.name: cancellation_channel

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the stated reason for cancellation. Used for churn analytics and product improvement initiatives. Empty value_regex indicates reference to external reason code lookup table with more than 6 values.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_description

attributes.description: The machine learning model-generated churn risk score that was assigned to the subscriber prior to the churn event. Range 0.0000 to 1.0000, where higher values indicate higher churn risk. Used for model validation and predictive accuracy assessment.

attributes.name: churn_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the subscriber cancellation or lapse event occurred. This is the business event timestamp representing when the subscriber relationship ended.

attributes.name: churn_type
attributes.description: Classification of the churn event based on the nature of cancellation. Voluntary indicates subscriber-initiated cancellation, involuntary indicates business-initiated termination, payment failure indicates cancellation due to billing issues.

attributes.name: competitor_service_mentioned_flag

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: customer_care_contact_count
attributes.description: The number of customer care interactions the subscriber had in the 30 days prior to churn. Used to identify service quality issues and early warning signals.

attributes.name: days_since_last_viewing
attributes.description: The number of days between the last viewing activity and the churn event. Used for engagement-based churn prediction models.

attributes.name: device_count_at_churn
attributes.description: The number of registered devices associated with the subscriber at the time of churn. Used for multi-device engagement analysis.

attributes.name: final_access_date
attributes.description: The last date the subscriber had active access to content and services. May differ from churn_timestamp due to grace periods or paid-through dates.

attributes.name: gdpr_data_deletion_requested_flag

attributes.name: last_viewing_date
attributes.description: The date of the subscribers last content viewing activity before churn. Used to identify engagement drop-off patterns and at-risk subscriber signals.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or context about the churn event captured by customer care agents or system processes.

attributes.name: parental_control_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether parental controls were enabled on the subscription at the time of churn. Used for family-oriented subscriber segmentation and churn analysis.

attributes.name: payment_failure_count
attributes.description: The number of consecutive payment failures that occurred before the churn event. Used to identify involuntary churn patterns and dunning effectiveness.

attributes.name: promotional_discount_active_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the subscriber had an active promotional discount at the time of churn. Used to analyze price sensitivity and promotional effectiveness.

attributes.name: reactivation_eligibility_date
attributes.description: The date when the churned subscriber becomes eligible for reactivation campaigns or promotional offers. Used for win-back campaign targeting and timing.

attributes.name: service_tier
attributes.description: The subscription service tier that was cancelled. SVOD (Subscription Video On Demand), AVOD (Advertising-Supported Video On Demand), TVOD (Transactional Video On Demand).

attributes.name: subscription_tenure_months
attributes.description: The total number of months the subscriber maintained an active subscription before churning. Used for cohort analysis and LTV (Lifetime Value) calculations.

attributes.name: total_lifetime_revenue
attributes.description: The cumulative revenue generated from this subscriber across their entire subscription tenure. Used for LTV (Lifetime Value) analysis and churn impact assessment.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this churn event record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: win_back_offer_accepted_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the subscriber accepted the win-back offer. True indicates acceptance and retention, False indicates rejection and churn completion. Null if no offer was presented.

attributes.name: win_back_offer_presented_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a retention or win-back offer was presented to the subscriber during the cancellation process. True indicates an offer was made, False indicates no offer was presented.

products.name: payment_instrument
products.description: Subscriber's stored payment instruments used for subscription billing. Captures payment method type (credit card, debit card, PayPal, direct debit, gift card, MVPD billing), masked card/account number, card brand, expiry date, billing address, is_default flag, and PCI DSS tokenization reference. Managed in Zuora as the payment method entity. Distinct from actual payment transactions owned by the billing domain.
products.reference: Zuora Payment Method / PCI DSS Token

attributes.name: payment_instrument_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment instrument record. Primary key.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscriber who owns this payment instrument. Links to the subscriber master record.

attributes.name: zuora_payment_method_id
attributes.description: External identifier for this payment method in the Zuora subscription billing system. Used for system integration and reconciliation.

attributes.name: bank_account_type
attributes.description: Type of bank account for direct debit or ACH payment methods. Null for card-based payment methods.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Bank routing number (ABA number in USA) for direct debit transactions. Masked or tokenized per PCI DSS requirements.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the billing address associated with the payment instrument. Used for address verification and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the billing address (apartment, suite, unit number). Optional field for additional address details.

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City of the billing address associated with the payment instrument.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the billing address (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN).

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the billing address. Used for address verification service (AVS) fraud checks.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the billing address. Format varies by country (e.g., two-letter state code for USA).

attributes.name: card_brand
attributes.description: The brand of the credit or debit card (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, JCB, Diners Club). Null for non-card payment methods.

attributes.name: cardholder_name
attributes.description: Name of the cardholder as it appears on the payment instrument. Required for card-based payment methods.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payment instrument record was first created in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment instrument (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Determines the currency for all transactions using this instrument.

attributes.name: deactivated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payment instrument was deactivated or closed. Null for active instruments. Used for lifecycle tracking and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: deactivation_reason
attributes.description: Reason why the payment instrument was deactivated. Used for churn analysis and payment method lifecycle management.

attributes.name: expiry_month
attributes.description: The month (1-12) when the payment instrument expires. Used for card expiration validation and renewal reminders.

attributes.name: expiry_year
attributes.description: The four-digit year when the payment instrument expires. Used for card expiration validation and renewal reminders.

attributes.name: failed_transaction_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of failed transaction attempts using this payment instrument. Used for fraud detection and payment method health monitoring.

attributes.name: gateway_reference_code
attributes.description: External reference identifier assigned by the payment gateway for this payment instrument. Used for gateway-specific operations and reconciliation.

attributes.name: gift_card_balance
attributes.description: Remaining balance on the gift card or prepaid card. Updated after each transaction. Null for non-gift-card payment methods.

attributes.name: gift_card_code
attributes.description: Masked gift card or prepaid card code. Full code is tokenized per PCI DSS requirements.

attributes.name: is_default
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the default payment instrument for the subscriber. Used for automatic billing and subscription renewals.

attributes.name: last_transaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent successful transaction using this payment instrument. Used for activity tracking and dormancy detection.

attributes.name: mandate_acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date when the subscriber accepted the direct debit mandate. Required for regulatory compliance and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: mandate_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the direct debit mandate or authorization. Required for SEPA and other direct debit payment methods to comply with banking regulations.

attributes.name: masked_account_number
attributes.description: Masked representation of the card or account number showing only the last 4 digits (e.g., ****1234). Full number is tokenized and stored securely per PCI DSS requirements.

attributes.name: payment_gateway
attributes.description: Name of the payment gateway or processor used for this payment instrument (e.g., Stripe, Braintree, Authorize.Net, Zuora Gateway).

attributes.name: payment_instrument_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment instrument. Active instruments can be charged; expired or suspended instruments require update or replacement.

attributes.name: payment_method_type
attributes.description: The type of payment instrument used for subscription billing. Indicates the payment mechanism (credit card, debit card, PayPal, direct debit, bank transfer, gift card, or MVPD billing).

attributes.name: payment_token
attributes.description: PCI DSS compliant tokenization reference for the actual payment instrument details. Used to process transactions without exposing sensitive cardholder data.

attributes.name: paypal_email
attributes.description: Email address associated with the PayPal account. Used for PayPal payment method identification and processing.

attributes.name: paypal_payer_reference
attributes.description: Unique PayPal payer identifier for the linked PayPal account. Used for PayPal billing agreement reference.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payment instrument record was last modified. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment instrument was successfully verified. Used for compliance tracking and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of payment instrument verification process. Indicates whether the payment method has been successfully validated through AVS, CVV check, or micro-deposit verification.

products.name: offer_redemption
products.description: Transactional record of a subscriber redeeming a promotional offer or discount code. Captures subscriber reference, offer reference, redemption timestamp, redemption channel, applied discount amount, resulting subscription plan, and redemption status (applied, expired, reversed). Enables promotion effectiveness tracking and revenue impact reconciliation.

attributes.name: offer_redemption_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the offer redemption transaction. Primary key for the offer redemption record.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign under which this offer was promoted. Enables campaign-level performance tracking and Return on Investment (ROI) analysis.

attributes.name: credit_memo_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.credit_memo. Business justification: When an offer redemption is reversed or results in a promotional credit, a credit memo is issued. Linking offer_redemption to credit_memo enables audit trail for promotional credit issuance, chargebac

attributes.name: distribution_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.distribution_agreement. Partner settlement an

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Finance teams reconcile promotional discount amounts applied via offer redemptions against specific invoices for revenue recognition, campaign ROI reporting, and audit compliance. offer_redemption.rev

attributes.name: offer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotional offer or discount campaign that was redeemed. Links to the offer master record.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution or retail partner through which the offer was distributed, if applicable. Null for direct-to-consumer offers.

attributes.name: qualifying_title_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.title. Business justification: Promotional offers often require viewing or purchasing specific titles (e.g., "watch premiere to unlock discount"). Supports campaign attribution, content-driven acquisition, and partnership promotion

attributes.name: resulting_subscription_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscription plan that the subscriber enrolled in or upgraded to as a result of this offer redemption. Links to the subscription plan master record.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscriber who redeemed the promotional offer. Links to the subscriber master record.

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific subscription instance that was created or modified as a result of this offer redemption. Links to the subscription record.

attributes.name: applied_discount_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the discount applied to the subscription as a result of this redemption. Expressed in the subscription currency.

attributes.name: attribution_source
attributes.description: The marketing source or touchpoint that led to this offer redemption. Examples include email campaign, social media ad, affiliate link, or organic search. Used for marketing attribution analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this offer redemption record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: discount_duration_months
attributes.description: The number of months for which the discount will be applied to the subscription. Null for one-time discounts or permanent pricing changes.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount applied when discount_type is percentage. Null for non-percentage discount types. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 25.00 for 25% off).

attributes.name: discount_type
attributes.description: The type of discount mechanism applied through this offer redemption. Determines how the discount value is calculated and applied to the subscription.

attributes.name: eligibility_failure_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the redemption was rejected or marked ineligible. Null if redemption was successful. Used for customer service and offer optimization.

attributes.name: eligibility_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscribers eligibility for the offer was verified at the time of redemption. True if eligibility checks passed, False otherwise.

attributes.name: first_time_subscriber_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this redemption resulted in a new subscriber acquisition (True) or was redeemed by an existing subscriber (False). Critical for Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and Lifetime Value (LTV) analysis.

attributes.name: offer_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the promotional offer expires and can no longer be redeemed. Used to validate redemption eligibility and track expired redemption attempts.

attributes.name: redemption_channel
attributes.description: The platform or channel through which the subscriber redeemed the offer. Enables channel effectiveness analysis for promotional campaigns.

attributes.name: redemption_code
attributes.description: The unique promotional code or voucher code entered by the subscriber at the time of redemption. Used for tracking and validation.

attributes.name: redemption_device_type
attributes.description: The type of device used by the subscriber to redeem the offer. Supports device-specific campaign optimization and user experience analysis.

attributes.name: redemption_ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address from which the redemption request originated. Used for fraud detection and geographic analysis. May be considered Personally Identifiable Information (PII) under General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

attributes.name: redemption_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the offer redemption. Tracks whether the redemption was successfully applied, expired before use, reversed due to policy violation, or rejected due to eligibility failure.

attributes.name: redemption_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the subscriber successfully redeemed the promotional offer. Represents the business event time of redemption.

attributes.name: revenue_impact_amount
attributes.description: The estimated impact on revenue resulting from this offer redemption. Negative values represent revenue reduction due to discounts; positive values may represent incremental revenue from new subscriptions or upgrades.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the offer redemption was reversed. Common reasons include fraud detection, policy violation, subscriber request, or billing dispute. Null if not reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the offer redemption was reversed or cancelled. Null if the redemption remains active. Used for chargeback and refund reconciliation.

attributes.name: terms_accepted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber explicitly accepted the terms and conditions associated with the promotional offer at the time of redemption. Required for compliance and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: terms_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the offer terms and conditions that the subscriber agreed to at redemption. Format: v1.0, v2.1, etc. Used for legal audit trails.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this offer redemption record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: zuora_subscription_number
attributes.description: The subscription identifier in the Zuora billing system that was created or modified as a result of this offer redemption. Used for billing reconciliation and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: max_devices

attributes.name: offer_status

attributes.description: URL to the legal terms and conditions document for this offer.

attributes.name: trial_duration_days
