attributes.name: panel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to audience.panel. Business justification: Reach and frequency reports are computed from panel-based audience measurement. Linking reach_frequency_report to the panel used for measurement enables quality assessment (MRC accreditation, cooperat

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner_partner. Business justification: Reach/frequency reports are often generated for specific distribution or syndication partners to demonstrate audience delivery against contractual obligations. Required for partner performance reporti

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.political_ad_record. Business justification: Reach/frequency reports for political campaigns require public inspection file linkage per FCC rules. Demonstrates delivery of reasonable access and documents audience delivery for political advertise

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Reach/frequency reports are formally submitted in FCC regulatory filings for political advertising equal opportunities compliance and public interest reporting. Compliance teams need this link to asse

attributes.name: sweeps_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to audience.sweeps_period. Business justification: Reach/frequency reports during sweeps periods are used for guarantee verification and makegood calculations. The is_sweeps_period flag indicates relevance, but the specific sweeps period should be ref

attributes.name: syndication_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.syndication_agreement. Business justification: Reach/frequency reports are generated specifically to validate syndication agreement performance guarantees and revenue share calculations. Syndicators require these reports per agreement to confirm a

attributes.name: audience_share_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the total viewing audience (persons using television) that was watching the specific network or program during the measurement period. Calculated as the program's audience divided by the total HUT/PUT audience. Used for competitive programming analysis and ad sales positioning.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; Nielsen Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: average_frequency
attributes.description: The average number of times a unique viewer within the target demographic was exposed to the content or campaign during the measurement period. Calculated as total impressions divided by unduplicated reach. Core metric for evaluating campaign saturation and makegoods calculation.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: cpm
attributes.description: The cost per one thousand audience impressions for the campaign or programming block, expressed in USD. Used by ad sales for post-campaign delivery validation, scatter market pricing justification, and makegood valuation. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial pricing.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Advertising Standards; Salesforce Media Cloud

attributes.name: cprp
attributes.description: The cost per one rating point delivered against the target demographic segment, expressed in USD. The primary pricing metric for linear TV advertising transactions. Used for upfront guarantee reconciliation, makegood valuation, and scatter market pricing. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial pricing.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this reach and frequency report record was first ingested into the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for data lineage tracking and pipeline monitoring.
attributes.references: Media Broadcasting Internal Data Standards; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values in this report (CPM, CPRP). Defaults to USD for domestic US markets. Required for international market reports and multi-currency financial reconciliation under SOX compliance.

attributes.name: delivery_variance_pct
attributes.description: The percentage difference between the guaranteed audience delivery (GRP or TRP) and the actual delivered audience for the campaign flight. A negative value indicates under-delivery triggering makegood obligations; a positive value indicates over-delivery. Used for upfront guarantee reconciliation and scatter market adjustments.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines; Wide Orbit

attributes.name: effective_reach_1plus
attributes.description: The count of unique persons exposed to the content or campaign at least one time (1+) during the measurement period. Equivalent to reach_persons; included as an explicit effective reach threshold field for consistency with N+ reporting framework used in post-campaign analysis.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: effective_reach_3plus
attributes.description: The count of unique persons exposed to the content or campaign at least three times (3+) during the measurement period. The industry-standard effective reach threshold used to assess whether sufficient frequency was achieved for advertising message recall. Critical for makegoods determination and campaign effectiveness evaluation.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: effective_reach_nplus
attributes.description: The count of unique persons exposed to the content or campaign at least N times (as defined by effective_reach_threshold) during the measurement period. Provides a configurable effective reach metric for custom campaign guarantee structures and advanced frequency analysis.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: effective_reach_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum number of exposures (N) used to define effective reach for this specific report. Configurable per campaign or client agreement (e.g., 3 for standard campaigns, 5 for high-frequency campaigns). Determines the N+ threshold applied in effective reach calculations beyond the standard 1+ and 3+ fields.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: grp
attributes.description: The sum of all rating points delivered by the campaign or programming block during the measurement period, representing total audience weight without deduplication. Calculated as reach percentage multiplied by average frequency. The primary currency for linear TV advertising transactions and upfront sales guarantees.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: hut_rating
attributes.description: The percentage of all television households in the market that had their television sets in use during the measurement period. Sourced from Nielsen Media Research Platform. Used as a contextual benchmark for evaluating audience share and competitive programming performance.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; Nielsen Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: is_makegood_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reach and frequency report has identified an audience delivery shortfall that requires a makegood (compensatory ad spot) to be issued to the advertiser. Triggers the makegood workflow in Wide Orbit and Salesforce Media Cloud when set to True.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: is_sweeps_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether the measurement period falls within a Nielsen sweeps period (an intensive ratings measurement period typically occurring in February, May, July, and November). Sweeps data carries elevated importance for programming decisions, ad rate setting, and affiliate compensation calculations.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; Nielsen Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: measurement_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the measurement window for which reach and frequency metrics are computed. Defines the end boundary of the campaign flight, programming block, or sweeps period being analyzed.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: measurement_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the measurement window for which reach and frequency metrics are computed. Defines the start boundary of the campaign flight, programming block, or sweeps period being analyzed. Used in conjunction with measurement_period_end_date to bound the audience measurement interval.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: measurement_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of measurement window for which this report was generated. 'campaign_flight' covers a defined ad campaign run; 'programming_block' covers a scheduled content block; 'daypart_window' covers a standard broadcast daypart; 'sweeps_period' covers an intensive Nielsen ratings measurement period; 'custom_window' covers an ad hoc analysis window.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: nielsen_report_code
attributes.description: The native report identifier assigned by the Nielsen Media Research Platform for this reach and frequency dataset. Used for source system traceability, data lineage, and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the Nielsen source system.

attributes.name: put_rating
attributes.description: The percentage of all persons in the target demographic who were watching television during the measurement period. Sourced from Nielsen Media Research Platform. Used alongside HUT to assess total available audience and calculate audience share for programming decisions.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; Nielsen Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: reach_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the target demographic universe reached at least once during the measurement period, calculated as (reach_persons / universe_estimate) × 100. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 45.2500 = 45.25%). Used by ad sales for post-campaign delivery reporting and scatter market pricing justification.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: reach_persons
attributes.description: The unduplicated count of unique persons within the target demographic segment who were exposed to the content or campaign at least once during the measurement period. The primary reach metric sourced from Nielsen Media Research Platform. Used for post-campaign delivery validation and upfront guarantee reconciliation.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: report_generated_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world event timestamp when this reach and frequency report was generated and delivered by the Nielsen Media Research Platform. Represents the business event time, distinct from audit timestamps. Used to track Nielsen data delivery SLAs and post-campaign reporting timeliness.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: report_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this reach and frequency report, sourced from the Nielsen Media Research Platform. Used by ad sales teams to reference specific post-campaign delivery reports in client communications, makegoods negotiations, and upfront guarantee reconciliation.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: report_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reach and frequency report. 'draft' indicates in-progress computation; 'preliminary' indicates initial Nielsen delivery pending validation; 'final' indicates validated and approved for client delivery; 'revised' indicates a corrected reissue; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer version; 'archived' indicates retired from active use.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: report_version
attributes.description: The version number of this reach and frequency report, incremented each time a revised or corrected report is issued by Nielsen or reprocessed in the lakehouse. Version 1 represents the initial delivery; subsequent versions represent corrections or revisions. Used to ensure ad sales teams are working with the most current data.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; Media Broadcasting Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: total_impressions
attributes.description: The total number of audience exposures (duplicated) to the content or campaign during the measurement period. Equals reach_persons multiplied by average_frequency. Used as the gross delivery metric for CPM-based advertising transactions and campaign pacing analysis.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Digital Advertising Standards

attributes.name: trp
attributes.description: The sum of rating points delivered specifically against the target demographic segment during the measurement period. Analogous to GRP but scoped to the defined target audience rather than the total population. Used for targeted advertising guarantee reconciliation and CPRP calculations.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: universe_estimate
attributes.description: The total estimated population size (in persons or households) of the target demographic segment in the specified market, as defined by Nielsen. Serves as the denominator for reach percentage calculations and rating point computations. Expressed as an absolute count.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this reach and frequency report record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Tracks revisions, status changes, and data corrections.
attributes.references: Media Broadcasting Internal Data Standards; SOX Compliance

products.name: guarantee
products.description: Master record of the audience delivery guarantee committed to an advertiser for a specific campaign or upfront deal — specifying the guaranteed GRP/TRP level, target demographic, measurement period, tolerance threshold, and makegood trigger conditions. Links to ad sales contracts and is reconciled against actual GRP delivery records. Central to revenue assurance and advertiser relationship management.

attributes.name: guarantee_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the audience delivery guarantee record. Primary key for the audience_guarantee data product in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.ad_order. Business justification: Audience guarantees are fulfilled through specific ad orders. Operations teams track which ad_order is executing a given GRP guarantee for delivery reconciliation and makegood triggering — a core name

attributes.description: Reference to the advertiser (party) to whom the audience delivery guarantee is committed. Sourced from Salesforce Media Cloud account records.
attributes.references: Salesforce Media Cloud CRM; IAB Digital Advertising Standards

attributes.name: affiliate_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.affiliate_agreement. Business justification: Audience guarantees issued to advertisers on affiliate-carried programming are governed by the affiliate agreement's local ad avails and clearance obligations. Linking guarantee to affiliate_agreement

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: The opportunity identifier in Salesforce Media Cloud CRM linked to this audience guarantee. Enables traceability from the sales pipeline through to audience delivery commitment and reconciliation.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertising campaign for which this audience delivery guarantee is established. Links to the campaign record in Salesforce Media Cloud or Wide Orbit.
attributes.references: Salesforce Media Cloud; IAB Digital Advertising Standards

attributes.name: demographic_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to audience.demographic_segment. Business justification: Guarantees target specific standardized demographic segments (e.g., A18-49, W25-54). The target_demographic_code and target_demographic_description are redundant with demographic_segment reference dat

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.channel. Business justification: Audience guarantees are often negotiated at the network/channel level for upfront deals. Direct channel link enables automated guarantee reconciliation, makegood issuance by channel, and channel-speci

attributes.description: Reference to the television network or channel on which the guaranteed audience delivery is to be achieved. Links to the network/channel master record used in scheduling and playout systems.
attributes.references: Ericsson MediaFirst Playout; Nielsen Media Research Platform

attributes.name: ott_platform_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.ott_platform. Business justification: Audience guarantees are platform-specific — an OTT guarantee is tied to a specific platform (e.g., Peacock GRP guarantee). 'platform_type' is a denormalized string. Linking guarantee to ott_platform e

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to audience.panel. Business justification: Audience delivery guarantees are measured against a specific Nielsen or proprietary panel. The panel defines the universe estimate, measurement methodology, and MRC accreditation status that governs w

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner_partner. Business justification: Audience guarantees are contractual commitments made to specific partners (advertisers, agencies, networks). Tracking the partner receiving the guarantee is essential for makegood fulfillment and cont

attributes.name: political_ad_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.political_ad_record. Business justification: Political advertising guarantees require special tracking for equal time and reasonable access compliance. Links guarantee delivery to political ad records for FCC public file documentation.

attributes.name: sales_proposal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_proposal. Business justification: Audience guarantees are negotiated and documented in sales proposals before being formalized in orders. Proposals specify guarantee terms (GRP/TRP thresholds, makegood provisions) that become contract

attributes.name: scheduling_daypart_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to scheduling.daypart. Business justification: Upfront guarantees specify daypart-level GRP/TRP commitments (e.g., Prime 18-49 rating guarantee). Direct daypart link enables automated delivery tracking, makegood triggering, and daypart-specific re

attributes.name: series_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.series. Business justification: Audience guarantees in upfront/scatter sales are negotiated against specific series (e.g., 'guaranteed X GRPs on Series Y'). The guarantee must reference the series to enable makegood calculations and

attributes.name: sweeps_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to audience.sweeps_period. Business justification: Audience guarantees are often tied to specific Nielsen sweeps periods for measurement and makegood calculations. The is_sweeps_period flag indicates relevance, but the specific sweeps period should be

attributes.name: actual_grp_delivered
attributes.description: The actual total GRP delivered against this guarantee as measured by the designated audience measurement source (e.g., Nielsen). Populated during and after the measurement period through reconciliation with actual delivery records. Used to determine whether the guarantee was met and whether makegoods are required.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: actual_trp_delivered
attributes.description: The actual total TRP delivered against this guarantee within the target demographic, as measured by the designated audience measurement source. Populated during reconciliation. Used alongside actual_grp_delivered to assess guarantee fulfillment for demographic-specific commitments.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this audience guarantee was formally approved and activated, transitioning from draft to active status. Represents the binding commitment date for revenue recognition and contractual obligation purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; SAP S/4HANA Financial Reporting; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing

attributes.name: cprp
attributes.description: The negotiated cost per rating point (CPRP) for this audience guarantee, expressed in the contract currency. CPRP is the standard pricing metric in broadcast advertising used to calculate the total value of the guarantee and to assess makegood compensation amounts.
attributes.references: IAB Audience Measurement Standards; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing; Media Broadcasting Industry Practice

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this audience guarantee record was first created in the system. Audit trail field used for data lineage, compliance reporting, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Internal Data Architecture Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the financial values associated with this audience guarantee (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Used in CPRP and total guarantee value calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA Financial Standards

attributes.name: deal_type
attributes.description: Classification of the advertising deal under which this guarantee was established. Upfront refers to advance advertising sales events; scatter refers to last-minute ad inventory sales; direct, programmatic, and sponsorship represent other deal structures common in media broadcasting.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Advertising Standards; Media Broadcasting Industry Practice

attributes.name: delivery_shortfall_grp
attributes.description: The calculated difference between the guaranteed GRP level and the actual GRP delivered (guaranteed_grp minus actual_grp_delivered). A positive value indicates under-delivery and potential makegood obligation. Populated during reconciliation.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Standards; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the audience delivery guarantee measurement period ends. Nullable for open-ended or rolling guarantees. Defines the close of the window during which GRP/TRP delivery is tracked.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the audience delivery guarantee measurement period begins. Defines the start of the window during which GRP/TRP delivery is tracked against the committed level.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: guarantee_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the audience guarantee, used in advertiser-facing documents, contracts, and reconciliation reports. Typically referenced in Wide Orbit sales orders and Salesforce Media Cloud opportunities.
attributes.references: IAB Audience Measurement Standards; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing

attributes.name: guarantee_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the audience guarantee. Draft indicates the guarantee is being negotiated; active indicates it is in-flight; at_risk indicates delivery is trending below threshold; breached indicates the guarantee was not met and makegoods are triggered; fulfilled indicates full delivery was achieved; cancelled indicates the guarantee was voided.
attributes.references: IAB Audience Measurement Standards; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing

attributes.name: guaranteed_frequency
attributes.description: The minimum average number of times a member of the target audience is exposed to the campaign (frequency) committed to the advertiser. Frequency is the average exposures per viewer. Used alongside reach guarantees for campaigns with specific exposure objectives.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: guaranteed_grp
attributes.description: The total Gross Rating Point (GRP) level committed to the advertiser for delivery over the measurement period. GRP is the sum of ratings for all ad spots in the campaign, representing total audience exposure as a percentage of the target universe. This is the contractually obligated delivery level.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Standards; GRP Industry Standard

attributes.name: guaranteed_reach
attributes.description: The minimum number of unique audience members (reach) committed to the advertiser over the measurement period. Reach is the count of distinct individuals exposed to the campaign at least once. Complements GRP/TRP guarantees for campaigns focused on unique audience coverage.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: guaranteed_trp
attributes.description: The total Target Rating Point (TRP) level committed to the advertiser, measured specifically against the defined target demographic segment. TRP is the GRP filtered to the target audience. Used when the guarantee is demographic-specific rather than total audience.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Standards; TRP Industry Standard

attributes.name: is_sweeps_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether the guarantee measurement period falls within a Nielsen sweeps period (intensive ratings measurement period). Sweeps periods (February, May, July, November) carry higher audience measurement scrutiny and may affect guarantee valuation and pricing.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; Nielsen Sweeps Measurement Standards

attributes.name: makegood_deadline_date
attributes.description: The contractual deadline by which makegood spots must be aired to compensate for any audience delivery shortfall. Critical for revenue assurance and advertiser relationship management.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing; IAB Audience Measurement Standards; Media Broadcasting Industry Practice

attributes.name: makegood_grp_issued
attributes.description: The total GRP value of makegood (compensatory ad spots) issued to the advertiser to compensate for audience delivery shortfall. Tracked for revenue assurance and advertiser relationship management. Zero if no makegoods were required.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing; IAB Audience Measurement Standards; Media Broadcasting Industry Practice

attributes.name: makegood_trigger_condition
attributes.description: Textual description of the specific conditions under which makegood (compensatory ad spots) obligations are activated. Defines the contractual rules for when and how makegoods must be provided to the advertiser when guaranteed audience delivery is not met. Sourced from the advertising contract terms.
attributes.references: IAB Audience Measurement Standards; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing; Media Broadcasting Industry Practice

attributes.name: nielsen_order_code
attributes.description: The external order or tracking identifier assigned by the Nielsen Media Research Platform for the audience measurement order associated with this guarantee. Used to cross-reference Nielsen ratings data and reconciliation reports.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; Nielsen Media Research Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional business context, special conditions, or operational notes related to this audience guarantee. May include negotiation history, special advertiser requirements, or reconciliation commentary.

attributes.name: rating_metric_type
attributes.description: Specifies the primary audience measurement metric on which this guarantee is based. GRP (Gross Rating Point) measures total audience exposure; TRP (Target Rating Point) measures exposure within the target demographic; HUT (Homes Using Television) and PUT (Persons Using Television) measure set usage; reach measures unique audience count; frequency measures average exposures per viewer.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the reconciliation process comparing guaranteed audience delivery against actual GRP/TRP delivery records. Pending indicates reconciliation has not started; in_progress indicates active comparison; reconciled indicates agreement reached; disputed indicates advertiser has contested the delivery figures; closed indicates the reconciliation cycle is complete.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing; Nielsen Media Research Platform; IAB Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: tolerance_threshold_pct
attributes.description: The acceptable percentage shortfall below the guaranteed GRP/TRP level before a makegood obligation is triggered. For example, a value of 5.00 means delivery must be within 5% of the guaranteed level. Defined in the advertising contract and used in reconciliation against actual delivery records.
attributes.references: IAB Audience Measurement Standards; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing; Media Broadcasting Industry Practice

attributes.name: total_guarantee_value
attributes.description: The total contracted monetary value of this audience guarantee, calculated as guaranteed GRP/TRP multiplied by CPRP. Represents the revenue at risk if the guarantee is not met and is central to revenue assurance and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Reporting; Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this audience guarantee record was last modified. Used for change tracking, incremental data processing in the lakehouse Silver Layer, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Internal Data Architecture Standard

attributes.name: wide_orbit_order_code
attributes.description: The sales order identifier in the Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing system associated with this audience guarantee. Used for cross-system reconciliation between audience delivery records and ad scheduling/invoicing.
attributes.references: Wide Orbit Traffic and Billing System

products.name: audience_profile
products.description: Anonymized/pseudonymized master record representing a unique audience member or household identity constructed from first-party data (subscriber records, app registrations, set-top box data) and third-party enrichment (Nielsen, Adobe AEP, data clean rooms). Captures hashed identity, device graph linkage, inferred demographic attributes, content affinity scores, platform preferences, viewing recency/frequency, and consent/privacy flags per GDPR, CCPA, and COPPA. Distinct from the subscriber SSOT in the subscriber domain — this is the audience intelligence and behavioral record, not the billing or subscription identity.
products.reference: Adobe Experience Platform Profile / Audience Identity

attributes.name: audience_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the audience profile record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: demographic_segment_id

attributes.name: ad_receptivity_score

attributes.name: aep_profile_code

attributes.name: avg_session_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Average duration in minutes of a single viewing session for this audience member, derived from set-top box or streaming platform telemetry. Represents Time Spent Viewing (TSV) at the individual level. Used for engagement scoring and content performance analytics.

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out

attributes.description: Indicates whether this California-resident audience member has exercised their CCPA right to opt out of the sale or sharing of their personal information. When TRUE, this profile must be excluded from data sharing with third-party ad networks and data clean rooms.

attributes.name: consent_last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: coppa_protected
attributes.business_glossary_term: Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) Protected Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audience profile is subject to COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act) protections, meaning the inferred or declared age is under 13. attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the audience member's country of residence. Used for rights windowing, content holdback enforcement, GDPR/CCPA jurisdictional compliance, and international distribution analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 3 (Territorial Scope); CCPA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this audience profile record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse, either through initial identity resolution, panel enrollment, or first-party data ingestion. Audit trail for data lineage and GDPR data minimization compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Minimization); Internal Data Governance Audit Standard

attributes.name: data_clean_room_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audience profile is eligible for inclusion in data clean room matching operations with advertising partners. Eligibility is determined by consent status, CCPA opt-out flag, COPPA protection status, and contractual data sharing agreements.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab — Data Clean Rooms Standards; GDPR Article 26 (Joint Controllers); CCPA

attributes.name: daypart_preference
attributes.description: Preferred daypart (time segment of the broadcast day) during which this audience member most frequently views content. Dayparts are standard broadcast industry time segments used for ad scheduling, upfront sales, and audience guarantee reporting.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform — Daypart Definitions; Wide Orbit Traffic System; IAB Video Ad Standards

attributes.name: device_graph_code
attributes.description: Cross-device graph linkage identifier that associates this audience profile with a cluster of known devices (smart TV, mobile, desktop, STB). Sourced from identity resolution providers or Adobe AEP device graph. Enables multi-screen reach and frequency measurement.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab — Addressability & Identity; Adobe Experience Platform Identity Service

attributes.name: enrichment_source_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the third-party enrichment data package (e.g., Nielsen demographic file version, Adobe AEP segment refresh batch ID) used to populate inferred attributes on this profile. Enables data lineage tracing and reproducibility of audience segment definitions.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform — Data Delivery Versioning; Adobe Experience Platform Data Governance

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Status
attributes.description: Current GDPR consent status for processing this audience member's personal data for audience measurement and advertising purposes. 'granted' permits processing; 'denied' or 'withdrawn' restricts processing; 'not_applicable' for non-EU audience members. Drives data processing eligibility.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis); GDPR Article 7 (Conditions for Consent); European Audiovisual Observatory

tag_set.value: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Status

attributes.name: household_size
attributes.description: Estimated number of persons in the audience household, derived from Nielsen panel data or set-top box signals. Used in HUT (Homes Using Television) and PUT (Persons Using Television) calculations for audience measurement reporting.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform — HUT/PUT Methodology; FCC Audience Measurement

attributes.name: hut_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this household-level audience profile is eligible to be counted in HUT (Homes Using Television) calculations. HUT measures the percentage of TV-equipped homes actively watching television during a given time period, a foundational metric for broadcast ratings.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform — HUT Methodology; FCC Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: identity_confidence_score
attributes.description: Confidence score (0.00–100.00) representing the reliability of the identity resolution that constructed this audience profile. Higher scores indicate stronger deterministic matching (e.g., authenticated login); lower scores indicate probabilistic device-graph inference. Used to qualify profiles for premium ad targeting.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab — Addressability & Identity Framework; Adobe Experience Platform Identity Service

attributes.name: identity_hash
attributes.description: SHA-256 pseudonymized hash of the audience member's primary identity (e.g., email or subscriber ID) used for cross-platform identity resolution without exposing raw PII. Enables privacy-safe linkage across Nielsen, Adobe AEP, and first-party data sources.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 & Article 25 (Privacy by Design); CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: identity_source
attributes.description: Originating source of the audience identity construction: 'first_party' (subscriber or app registration data), 'nielsen' (Nielsen Media Research panel linkage), 'adobe_aep' (Adobe Experience Platform profile), 'set_top_box' (STB device-level data), 'clean_room' (data clean room match), or 'modeled' (probabilistic inference).
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; Adobe Experience Platform; IAB Data Transparency Standards

attributes.name: income_band
attributes.description: Inferred household income band derived from third-party demographic enrichment (Nielsen, data clean rooms). Used for premium audience segmentation in upfront and scatter market ad sales, enabling CPM pricing differentiation by audience affluence.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform — Demographic Enrichment; IAB Audience Taxonomy v3

attributes.name: inferred_age_band
attributes.description: Inferred age demographic band for the audience member, derived from Nielsen panel data, set-top box signals, or modeled enrichment. Used for GRP/TRP demographic targeting and ad sales audience guarantees. Not directly collected from the individual.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform — Demographic Segmentation; IAB Audience Taxonomy v3

attributes.name: inferred_gender
attributes.description: Inferred gender of the audience member derived from panel data or modeled signals. Used for demographic audience targeting in ad sales (GRP/TRP calculations) and programming decisions. Not directly collected.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform — Demographic Segmentation; IAB Audience Taxonomy v3

attributes.name: last_seen_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent observed audience activity event (viewing session, app interaction, or platform login) for this profile. Used to determine audience recency, drive re-engagement campaigns, and calculate viewing recency metrics.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Profile Last Activity; Nielsen Audience Engagement

attributes.name: nielsen_grp_index
attributes.description: Indexed GRP (Gross Rating Point) score for this audience profile relative to the total population, sourced from Nielsen Media Research. A GRP index above 100 indicates above-average exposure to rated content. Used in ad sales audience guarantees and upfront negotiations.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform — GRP Methodology; FCC Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: panel_weight_factor
attributes.description: Statistical weighting factor assigned by Nielsen to this panel member profile to project panel observations to the total population. Applied in GRP, TRP, HUT, and PUT calculations. Null for non-panel (modeled or first-party only) profiles.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform — Panel Weighting Methodology; MRC Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: platform_preference
attributes.description: Primary viewing platform preference inferred from behavioral signals: 'linear_tv' (traditional scheduled broadcast), 'svod' (Subscription Video On Demand), 'avod' (Advertising-Supported VOD), 'tvod' (Transactional VOD), 'fast' (Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV), 'ott' (Over-The-Top), 'mvpd' (Multichannel Video Programming Distributor), or 'vmvpd' (Virtual MVPD). Drives distribution strategy and ad product targeting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: linear_tv|svod|avod|tvod|fast|ott|mvpd|vmvpd — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Spend Report; ATSC 3.0 Standards; DVB Project

attributes.name: primary_device_type
attributes.description: The primary device type through which this audience member most frequently consumes content, derived from device graph and behavioral data. Used for CDN delivery optimization, ad format targeting, and platform analytics.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab — Device Type Taxonomy; Akamai CDN Analytics

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the audience profile. 'suppressed' indicates a privacy opt-out or regulatory hold; 'pending_consent' indicates consent collection is in progress; 'purged' indicates the record has been anonymized per GDPR/CCPA erasure request.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); CCPA Section 1798.105; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: profile_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audience profile record: 'individual' (single person identity), 'household' (aggregated household unit), 'panel_member' (Nielsen or equivalent panel participant), or 'modeled' (synthetically constructed from behavioral signals without direct identity linkage).
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform — Audience Segmentation Standards; IAB Audience Taxonomy

attributes.name: sweeps_period_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audience profile's measurement data was captured during a Nielsen Sweeps period (intensive ratings measurement period: February, May, July, November). Sweeps data carries higher statistical weight in ratings calculations and programming decisions.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform — Sweeps Methodology; FCC Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: trp_index
attributes.description: Indexed TRP (Target Rating Point) score representing this audience member's contribution to a specific demographic target group's rating. Distinct from GRP in that it measures reach within a defined target demographic. Used for demographic-specific ad campaign planning and post-campaign analysis.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform — TRP Methodology; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this audience profile record, triggered by enrichment refresh, consent status change, identity graph update, or behavioral signal ingestion. Used for data freshness monitoring and incremental processing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accuracy); Internal Data Governance Audit Standard; Adobe Experience Platform

attributes.name: viewing_recency_days
attributes.description: Number of days since this audience member last engaged with any content on any tracked platform. Used for audience recency segmentation, churn prediction, and re-engagement campaign targeting. Lower values indicate more recently active audiences.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform — Recency-Frequency-Monetary (RFM) Segmentation; Nielsen Audience Engagement Metrics

attributes.name: weekly_viewing_frequency
attributes.description: Average number of distinct viewing sessions per week for this audience member, calculated over a rolling 4-week window. Represents the Frequency dimension of audience measurement (average exposures per viewer). Used in reach and frequency reporting for ad campaign delivery.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform — Reach and Frequency Methodology; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

Captures segment name, definition logic, estimated size, demographic composition, platform applicability, activation status, and data source (Nielsen, Adobe AEP, first-party). Distinct from demographic_segment (which is a reference classification) — this is an operationally managed, business-owned targeting segment.

attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the segment governing whether it is available for use in ad targeting, campaign activation, or content personalization. 'draft' indicates under construction; 'pending_review' awaits compliance or data governance approval; 'active' is live and deployable; 'inactive' is suspended; 'archived' is retired.

attributes.name: aep_segment_code
attributes.description: The segment identifier as defined and managed within Adobe Experience Platform (AEP). attributes.name: age_range_max
attributes.description: Maximum age (inclusive) of the primary demographic target for this segment, expressed in years. Used with age_range_min to define the Nielsen demographic cell. A null value indicates an open-ended upper bound (e.g., '55+' segments).
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Demographic Standards; IAB Audience Taxonomy

attributes.name: age_range_min
attributes.description: Minimum age (inclusive) of the primary demographic target for this segment, expressed in years. Used in conjunction with age_range_max to define the Nielsen demographic cell (e.g., 25 for the 'Adults 25-54' standard Nielsen demo). Null if the segment is not age-bounded.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Demographic Standards; IAB Audience Taxonomy

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the data governance or compliance approver who authorized this segment for activation, particularly for segments involving sensitive demographic data, COPPA-restricted audiences, or GDPR-regulated EU audiences. Supports audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accountability Principle); COPPA Compliance; Media Broadcasting Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this segment received formal data governance or compliance approval for activation. Distinct from created_timestamp — captures the approval lifecycle event. Required for GDPR accountability documentation and internal audit trails. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accountability Principle); Media Broadcasting Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Business-facing category grouping segments for portfolio management and reporting (e.g., 'Ad Targeting', 'Programming Strategy', 'Content Personalization', 'Subscriber Retention', 'Regulatory Reporting'). Enables segment library organization in Salesforce Media Cloud and Adobe AEP. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ad_targeting|programming_strategy|content_personalization|subscriber_retention|regulatory_reporting|audience_research — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Audience Taxonomy; Adobe Experience Platform Segment Classification

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the segment used across systems such as Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Nielsen, and Salesforce Media Cloud. Serves as the canonical cross-system reference code (e.g., 'SEG-DEMO-F25-54-OTT').
attributes.references: IAB Audience Taxonomy; Adobe Experience Platform Segment Naming Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this audience segment record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage, governance, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Confidentiality); SOX Section 404 (Internal Controls); Media Broadcasting Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Identifies the primary data origin used to construct the segment. 'nielsen' indicates Nielsen Media Research Platform ratings and demographic data; 'adobe_aep' indicates Adobe Experience Platform behavioral profiles; 'first_party' indicates proprietary subscriber or registration data; 'third_party' indicates licensed external data; 'hybrid' indicates a combination of multiple sources.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Platform; Adobe Experience Platform; IAB Data Transparency Standards

attributes.name: daypart_applicability
attributes.description: Broadcast daypart(s) for which this segment is most relevant or has been validated, expressed as a comma-delimited list of standard daypart labels (e.g., 'primetime,late_night'). Daypart is a standard media-buying time segment of the broadcast day used in ad scheduling and upfront sales. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: early_morning|daytime|early_fringe|primetime|late_news|late_night|overnight — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Daypart Definitions; Wide Orbit Traffic System Daypart Standards

attributes.name: definition_logic
attributes.description: The rule-based or SQL/JSON expression that defines segment membership criteria as implemented in Adobe AEP or Nielsen. Captures the inclusion/exclusion logic (e.g., age range, viewing frequency thresholds, content genre affinity, platform usage) used to qualify audience members into this segment.
attributes.references: Adobe Experience Platform Segment Builder; Nielsen Audience Workbench

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the segment's business purpose, defining criteria, and intended use cases. Provides context for ad sales teams, programmers, and data analysts on what the segment represents and how it should be applied.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this segment definition is considered valid and available for business use. Segments may be pre-built ahead of upfront sales seasons or campaign launches. Enables temporal validity management for segment versioning and historical reporting.
attributes.references: Media Broadcasting Internal Data Governance Standards; IAB Audience Data Lifecycle

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date after which this segment definition is no longer valid for new activations. Null indicates an open-ended segment with no planned expiry. Used to manage seasonal segments (e.g., sweeps-period segments), campaign-specific segments, and segments tied to expiring data licensing agreements.
attributes.references: Media Broadcasting Internal Data Governance Standards; IAB Audience Data Lifecycle

attributes.name: estimated_reach
attributes.description: Estimated number of unique individuals (persons or households) who qualify for this segment at the time of last refresh. Reach is a core Nielsen and IAB metric used in ad sales proposals, GRP/TRP calculations, and CPM pricing. Distinct from impressions — counts unique audience members, not exposures.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Audience Measurement Standards; IAB Reach and Frequency Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: estimated_reach_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the estimated_reach figure. 'persons' aligns with Nielsen PUT (Persons Using Television) methodology; 'households' aligns with HUT (Homes Using Television); 'devices' applies to digital/OTT platform segments measured by device-level identity.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research HUT/PUT Measurement Standards; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: gender_target
attributes.description: Gender composition target for the segment as defined in Nielsen demographic cells and ad sales targeting parameters. 'all' indicates gender-neutral targeting. Used in GRP (Gross Rating Point) and TRP (Target Rating Point) calculations for ad campaign planning.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research Demographic Standards; IAB Audience Taxonomy

attributes.name: grp_index
attributes.description: The GRP (Gross Rating Point) index value representing this segment's relative audience weight as a percentage of the total universe. GRP is a fundamental media planning metric equal to Reach × Frequency. Used in upfront and scatter market ad sales to price inventory and measure campaign delivery against this segment.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research GRP Methodology; IAB Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: hut_put_basis
attributes.description: Indicates whether the segment's reach and rating metrics are calculated on a HUT (Homes Using Television) or PUT (Persons Using Television) basis. HUT is household-level measurement; PUT is person-level. This distinction governs how GRP/TRP values are interpreted and how the segment is applied in Nielsen-based ad sales planning.
attributes.references: Nielsen Media Research HUT/PUT Methodology Standards

attributes.name: income_bracket
attributes.description: Household income tier associated with the segment's demographic composition, used in premium ad targeting and CPM (Cost Per Mille) pricing. Expressed as a standardized range label (e.g., '$75K-$100K HHI', '$100K+ HHI'). Sourced from Nielsen MRI-Simmons or first-party subscriber data. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: under_25k|25k_50k|50k_75k|75k_100k|100k_150k|150k_plus — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: is_dai_eligible

DAI-eligible segments can be activated in real-time ad decisioning systems integrated with Akamai CDN and programmatic ad servers for addressable advertising.
attributes.references: SCTE-130 Dynamic Ad Insertion Standard; IAB VAST/VMAP Standards; Akamai DAI Integration

attributes.name: is_sweeps_validated

attributes.name: platform_applicability

products.name: segment_membership
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of an audience profile to a defined audience segment for use in ad targeting, programming strategy, and content personalization. It captures the membership relationship with scoring, temporal validity, activation status, and confidence metrics that exist only in the context of this specific profile-segment pairing. Each record links one audience_profile to one segment with attributes that govern targeting eligibility and measurement.. Existence Justification: In media broadcasting audience management, a single audience profile is routinely assigned to multiple segments simultaneously for different targeting purposes (e.g., 'Sports Enthusiasts', 'High Income HH', 'Prime Time Viewers'), and each segment contains thousands to millions of profiles. Segment membership is an operationally managed business concept recognized in Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and Nielsen measurement systems, with membership tracked via scores, temporal validity windows, activation status, and confidence metrics that belong to each specific profile-segment pairing, not to the profile or segment alone.

domains.name: billing

Integrates with Zuora (subscription billing), Wide Orbit (ad billing), and SAP S/4HANA (financial posting).

Supports stream-specific extended attributes: subscription plan/proration for SVOD billing, Wide Orbit order ID/ISCI codes for ad billing, MVPD subscriber count basis for carriage fees, and license window/installment schedule for syndication. Serves as the SSOT for all billing documents across all revenue streams.

Supports multi-jurisdiction tax compliance for subscriber billing (CCPA, GDPR jurisdictions) and international syndication license fee withholding.

attributes.description: Reference to the billing invoice transaction to which this tax record applies. Links tax calculation to the parent billing document.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment. Business justification: Tax record can be associated with ONE payment (tax withholding on payments, especially for international syndication payments). Need FK to payment for tax withholding tracking and compliance. No redun

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Tax records for international syndication (withholding tax, VAT) may require regulatory filing references for cross-border compliance (e.g., IRS Form 1042, EU VAT MOSS filings). Links tax and regulato

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Tax records must track which regulatory obligation they fulfill (FCC regulatory fees, state sales tax mandates, VAT compliance). Finance teams need to map tax payments to specific regulatory requireme

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the taxable and tax amounts (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: customer_tax_classification
attributes.description: Tax classification of the customer for determining applicable tax treatment. Business (B2B), Individual (B2C), Government, Non-Profit, Exempt Organization.

attributes.name: customer_tax_number
attributes.description: The customer's tax identification number (TIN, VAT number, GST number, EIN, etc.) used for tax reporting and validation. Format varies by jurisdiction.
attributes.references: OECD Common Reporting Standard, Local Tax Authority Standards

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax record is under dispute with the tax authority or customer (True = disputed, False = not disputed).

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the tax dispute (e.g., Incorrect jurisdiction, Rate disagreement, Exemption certificate rejected, Nexus challenge). Populated when dispute_flag is True.

attributes.name: nexus_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where tax nexus is established (e.g., USA, GBR, FRA, CAN).

attributes.name: nexus_state_province
attributes.description: State or province where the business has established tax nexus (physical or economic presence triggering tax obligation). Critical for US sales tax and Canadian GST/PST compliance.
attributes.references: US Supreme Court South Dakota v. Wayfair, Local Tax Nexus Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special circumstances, manual adjustments, or audit notes related to this tax calculation.

attributes.name: remittance_date
attributes.description: Date when the tax amount was remitted (paid) to the tax authority. Null if remittance_status is pending or disputed.

attributes.name: remittance_reference_number
attributes.description: Payment reference or confirmation number from the tax authority acknowledging receipt of the tax remittance. Used for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: remittance_status
attributes.description: Current status of tax payment to the tax authority. Pending (not yet paid), Remitted (paid in full), Partially Remitted (partial payment made), Disputed (under review or appeal), Waived (exempted or forgiven).

attributes.name: reverse_charge_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reverse charge mechanism applies (True = customer is responsible for self-assessing and remitting VAT/GST, False = supplier charges and remits tax). Common in EU cross-border B2B transactions.

attributes.name: source_system_tax_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this tax record in the source operational system. Enables traceability and reconciliation back to the originating system.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Calculated tax amount for this jurisdiction and tax type (taxable_amount × tax_rate). Denominated in the invoice currency.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Revenue Recognition, Local Tax Regulations

attributes.name: tax_authority
attributes.description: Name of the governmental tax authority responsible for collection and enforcement (e.g., IRS, HMRC, California Department of Tax and Fee Administration, Direction Générale des Finances Publiques).

attributes.name: tax_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the tax amount. Automated (system-calculated), Manual (finance team entry), Third-Party Service (Avalara, Vertex, TaxJar), Override (manual adjustment to automated calculation).

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Business categorization of the taxable item or service (e.g., Subscription Services, Advertising Services, Content Licensing, Equipment Rental, Digital Downloads). Used for tax rate determination and reporting segmentation.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the tax exemption certificate on file, if applicable. Required for audit trail when exemption is claimed.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a tax exemption was applied to this transaction (True = exemption applied, False = no exemption).

attributes.name: tax_exemption_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or regulatory basis for the tax exemption (e.g., Non-profit organization, Government entity, Educational institution, Resale certificate, Export transaction).

attributes.name: tax_filing_due_date
attributes.description: The statutory due date for filing the tax return that includes this transaction, based on the tax jurisdiction and filing period.

attributes.name: tax_filing_period
attributes.description: The tax reporting period to which this transaction applies, formatted as YYYY-Q# for quarterly or YYYY-M## for monthly (e.g., 2024-Q1, 2024-M03). Aligns with jurisdiction-specific filing schedules.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax jurisdiction (country, state, province, county, or municipality) where the tax obligation arises. Format: ISO country code optionally followed by subdivision code (e.g., US-CA, GB, FR-75).

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Full name of the tax jurisdiction (e.g., California, United Kingdom, Paris) for human-readable reporting and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: tax_line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number for this tax record within the parent invoice, supporting multiple tax jurisdictions or tax types per invoice.

attributes.name: tax_point_date
attributes.description: The date when the tax liability arises according to tax regulations (also known as time of supply). May differ from transaction_date based on jurisdiction-specific rules for services, advance payments, or continuous supplies.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC, Local Tax Authority Standards

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Tax rate applied to the taxable amount, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0825 for 8.25%). Supports precision to six decimal places for complex multi-jurisdictional calculations.

attributes.name: tax_treatment_code
attributes.description: Internal or regulatory code defining the specific tax treatment applied (e.g., standard rate, reduced rate, zero-rated, exempt, out-of-scope). Maps to jurisdiction-specific tax rules.
attributes.references: Local Tax Authority Standards, Internal Tax Policy

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: Type of tax applied to the transaction. Sales Tax (US state/local), VAT (Value-Added Tax, EU/international), GST (Goods and Services Tax), Withholding Tax (international syndication/licensing), Excise Tax (specific content types), Use Tax (cross-border digital services).
attributes.references: OECD Tax Standards, Local Tax Authority Regulations

attributes.name: taxable_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the invoice amount subject to taxation in this jurisdiction, after applying exemptions and exclusions. Denominated in the invoice currency.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Revenue Recognition, Local Tax Regulations

attributes.name: third_party_tax_service
attributes.description: Name of the external tax calculation service provider if third-party method was used (e.g., Avalara AvaTax, Vertex Cloud, TaxJar, Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE).

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The date of the underlying billing transaction that triggered the tax calculation. Used to determine applicable tax rates and rules in effect at the time of transaction.
attributes.references: ASC 606 Revenue Recognition, Local Tax Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax record was last modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: coproduction_participation
products.description: This association product represents the participation relationship between a co-production agreement and a partner organization. It captures the multi-party nature of co-production arrangements where multiple partners (studios, production houses, international broadcasters) jointly finance and produce content. Each record links one co-production agreement to one participating partner with financial terms (investment percentage, IP ownership percentage, revenue share), creative terms (partner role, credit obligations), and territorial rights allocation that exist only in the context of this specific partnership arrangement.. Existence Justification: In the media broadcasting industry, co-production agreements are inherently multi-party arrangements where multiple partners (studios, production houses, international broadcasters) jointly finance and produce content. Each partner's participation has distinct financial terms (investment percentage, IP ownership percentage, revenue share), creative terms (role, credit obligations), and territorial rights. The current model's lead_partner_id captures only the primary partner, leaving co-financing and co-distribution partners unmodeled, which fails to represent the fundamental business reality that co-productions involve multiple simultaneous partnerships.

      expr: approval_status
      comment: "Budget approval status for tracking approval pipeline"
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Original currency code for multi-currency analysis"

      expr: is_greenlight_budget
      comment: "Flag indicating greenlight budget for strategic project tracking"

      expr: YEAR(period_start_date)
      comment: "Calendar year extracted from budget period start date"
    - name: "budget_quarter"
      expr: CONCAT('Q', QUARTER(period_start_date))
      comment: "Calendar quarter for quarterly budget analysis"
  measures:
    - name: "total_approved_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(approved_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total approved budget amount across all budget lines"
    - name: "total_actual_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_cost_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual cost incurred to date"
    - name: "total_forecast_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(forecast_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total forecasted spend for budget planning"
    - name: "total_variance_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(variance_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total variance between approved and actual spend (positive = under budget, negative = over budget)"
    - name: "total_committed_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(committed_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total committed spend (contractually obligated but not yet paid)"
    - name: "total_contingency_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(contingency_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total contingency reserves held for risk mitigation"
    - name: "avg_contingency_percentage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(contingency_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average contingency percentage across budgets for risk planning benchmarks"
    - name: "budget_utilization_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(actual_cost_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(approved_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of approved budget actually spent (key efficiency and control metric)"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `vibe_media_broadcasting_v1`.`_metrics`.`subscriber_churn_event`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Churn analysis metrics tracking subscriber attrition, reasons, lifetime value lost, and win-back effectiveness to inform retention strategies and reduce revenue leakage."
  source: "`vibe_media_broadcasting_v1`.`subscriber`.`churn_event`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "churn_type"
      expr: churn_type
      comment: "Type of churn event (voluntary, involuntary, payment failure, competitive, etc.)"
    - name: "cancellation_channel"
      expr: cancellation_channel
      comment: "Channel through which cancellation was processed (web, mobile, call center, email, etc.)"
    - name: "cancellation_reason_code"
      expr: cancellation_reason_code
      comment: "Standardized reason code for cancellation"
    - name: "cancellation_reason_description"
      expr: cancellation_reason_description
      comment: "Detailed description of cancellation reason"
    - name: "competitor_service_mentioned_flag"
      expr: competitor_service_mentioned_flag
      comment: "Whether a competitor service was mentioned as reason for churn"
    - name: "win_back_offer_presented_flag"
      expr: win_back_offer_presented_flag
      comment: "Whether a win-back offer was presented to the churning subscriber"
    - name: "win_back_offer_accepted_flag"
      expr: win_back_offer_accepted_flag
      comment: "Whether the win-back offer was accepted by the subscriber"
    - name: "promotional_discount_active_flag"
      expr: promotional_discount_active_flag
      comment: "Whether a promotional discount was active at time of churn"
    - name: "service_tier"
      expr: service_tier
      comment: "Service tier of the subscription at time of churn"
    - name: "churn_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', churn_timestamp)
      comment: "Month when churn occurred, for trend analysis"
    - name: "churn_year"
      expr: YEAR(churn_timestamp)
      comment: "Year when churn occurred"
    - name: "subscription_tenure_months"
      expr: subscription_tenure_months
      comment: "Number of months the subscriber was active before churning"
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency code for revenue metrics"
  measures:
    - name: "total_churn_events"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of churn events"
    - name: "unique_churned_subscribers"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT subscriber_id)
      comment: "Distinct count of subscribers who churned"

      expr: profile_status
      comment: "Status of the talent profile (active, inactive, suspended, archived)"
    - name: "clearance_status"
      expr: clearance_status
      comment: "Clearance status for the talent (cleared, pending, expired, denied)"
    - name: "union_affiliation"
      expr: union_affiliation
      comment: "Union or guild affiliation of the talent"
    - name: "work_authorization_status"
      expr: work_authorization_status
      comment: "Work authorization status (authorized, visa required, pending, expired)"
    - name: "gender_identity"
      expr: gender_identity
      comment: "Gender identity of the talent"
    - name: "nationality"
      expr: nationality
      comment: "Nationality of the talent"
    - name: "primary_language"
      expr: primary_language
      comment: "Primary language of the talent"
    - name: "exclusivity_clause_flag"
      expr: exclusivity_clause_flag
      comment: "Whether the talent has active exclusivity clauses"
    - name: "residual_eligibility_flag"
      expr: residual_eligibility_flag
      comment: "Whether the talent is eligible for residual payments"
    - name: "insurance_coverage_flag"
      expr: insurance_coverage_flag
      comment: "Whether the talent has active insurance coverage"
    - name: "gdpr_consent_status"
      expr: gdpr_consent_status
      comment: "GDPR consent status for the talent profile"
    - name: "ccpa_opt_out_flag"
      expr: ccpa_opt_out_flag
      comment: "Whether the talent has opted out under CCPA"
    - name: "biometric_consent_flag"
      expr: biometric_consent_flag
      comment: "Whether the talent has consented to biometric data use"
  measures:
    - name: "total_talent_profile_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of talent profiles in the system"
    - name: "active_talent_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN profile_status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of active talent profiles"
    - name: "cleared_talent_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN clearance_status = 'cleared' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of talent profiles with current clearance"
    - name: "clearance_expired_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN clearance_status = 'expired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of talent profiles with expired clearance"
    - name: "union_affiliated_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN union_affiliation IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of talent profiles with union affiliation"
    - name: "work_authorized_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN work_authorization_status = 'authorized' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of talent profiles with valid work authorization"
    - name: "exclusivity_clause_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN exclusivity_clause_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of talent profiles with active exclusivity clauses"
    - name: "residual_eligible_talent_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN residual_eligibility_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of talent profiles eligible for residual payments"
    - name: "insured_talent_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN insurance_coverage_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of talent profiles with active insurance coverage"
    - name: "gdpr_consented_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN gdpr_consent_status = 'consented' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of talent profiles with GDPR consent"
    - name: "ccpa_opt_out_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN ccpa_opt_out_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of talent profiles opted out under CCPA"
    - name: "biometric_consent_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN biometric_consent_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of talent profiles with biometric consent"
    - name: "distinct_agency_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT talent_agency_id)
      comment: "Number of unique talent agencies representing talent in the system"
$$
metric_views.description: Talent profile metrics tracking workforce composition, clearance status, union coverage, and regulatory compliance for talent roster management.
